jobs.title: Director, Software Engineering – Acute Devices
jobs.description:
Vantive is a vital organ therapy company on a mission to extend lives and expand possibilities for patients and care teams everywhere. For 70 years, our team has driven meaningful innovations in kidney care. As we build on our legacy, we are deepening our commitment to elevating the dialysis experience through digital solutions and advanced services, while looking beyond kidney care and investing in transforming vital organ therapies. Greater flexibility and efficiency in therapy administration for care teams, and longer, fuller lives for patients— that is what Vantive aspires to deliver.

We believe Vantive will not only build our leadership in the kidney care space, it will also offer meaningful work to those who join us. At Vantive, you will become part of a community of people who are focused, courageous and don’t settle for the mediocre. Each of us is driven to help improve patients’ lives worldwide. Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities.

As the Global Software Leader for Acute Products/ Devices, this role is responsible for leading multi-site device software engineering team for Acute Care products by defining and driving software strategy and implementation and delivering to all Acute Care product lines. As the Global Device Software Leader for Acute Care product lines of Vantive, works in collaboration with commercial, systems, program management, Quality & Regulatory functional leadership teams to build and execute on product strategy, roadmaps and delivery plans.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Own product-line software strategy and roadmaps for device software for all acute products; aligning with business and product strategy and therapy needs.
Lead Acute global device software team, including functional managers and technical leaders.
Lead defining and implementing technology and software architecture strategy working with Acute device software leaders and in collaboration with systems leaders
Lead Acute global device software team in building execution plans and driving execution to deliver to the product roadmaps and releases across all Acute product lines.
Create, effectively communicate, and realize vision and strategy for the organization that aligns with the business and customer needs.
Establish an organization structure that ensures clear accountability and operational excellence.
Develop and mentor high-performing managers and technical leaders; build succession plans and communities of practice across global sites.
Provide strategic planning leadership for resource staffing and project execution with proactive management of technical and project risk to ensure delivery of business commitments
Leverages deep knowledge of technology/process/therapy domains, user needs, hazards, risk, and business targets and budgets to drive solutions and product design realization.
Management of technical and project risk to ensure delivery of business commitments.
Drive post-market software change management strategy, field data analytics, and reliability improvements with contained risk and minimal therapy disruption.
Embrace and embed agile ways of working in support of a fail-fast-learn-fast culture and enabling continual improvement.
Foster a collaborative work environment with strong working relationships within and across businesses and functions, and with strategic external partners.
Maintain current knowledge of relevant Quality System Regulations and other regulatory requirements related to research and development (medical product development, design, safety, Cyber Security) to ensure compliance in all research, development, data collection and reporting activities.

Qualifications

Significant experience in Electro-mechanical devices and device software engineering.
Understanding of global regulatory requirements for medical devices; risk and reliability concepts for development; and the need to deliver quality products and/or processes.
Significant experience leading a globally distributed team and working in a global matrix environment.
Strong team building and talent management skills, and the ability to motivate team members to achieve goals.
Proven experience in driving product specific and overall portfolio strategy, specific to software technology, in a global business.
Must possess strong knowledge of scientific/technical disciplines and solid knowledge of related disciplines such as regulatory, quality, and/or product development.
Recognized internally and externally as expert in functional area.
Must be a strategic, innovative problem solver, and have strong influencing and communication skills.
Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills across Clinical, RA/QA, Systems, Operations, and suppliers.

Education and/or Experience

Bachelor’s degree in electrical/computer/software engineering (Master’s preferred). Experience in medical devices or other safety‑critical electromechanical domains (e.g., aerospace, industrial controls, automotive) required; medical device experience strongly preferred.

We understand compensation is an important factor as you consider the next step in your career. At Vantive, we are committed to equitable pay for all employees, and we strive to be more transparent with our pay practices. The estimated base salary for this position is $200,000 - $275,000 annually. The estimated range is meant to reflect an anticipated salary range for the position. We may pay more or less than the anticipated range based upon market data and other factors, all of which are subject to change. Individual pay is based on upon location, skills and expertise, experience, and other relevant factors. For questions about this, our pay philosophy, and available benefits, please speak to the recruiter if you decide to apply and are selected for an interview.

This is where your well-being matters. Vantive offers comprehensive compensation and benefits packages for eligible roles. Our health and well-being benefits include medical, dental and vision coverage that start on day one, as well as insurance coverage for basic life, accident, short-term and long-term disability, and business travel accident insurance. Financial and retirement benefits include the Aon Pooled Employer Plan (“Aon PEP”), Vantive’s 401(k) retirement savings plan, to help you prepare for your future. The Aon PEP is designed to help improve retirement outcomes by providing retirement resources more efficiently. Additional benefits include commuting benefits, the Employee Discount Program, the Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and childcare benefits. jobs.description:
Working Title
Director of Broadcast Engineering & Technology

Department
University Television-0912

Description Of Work

The Director of Broadcast Engineering & Technology provides strategic and operational leadership for the Nebraska Public Media’s broadcast, production, and distribution technologies across statewide television and FM radio platforms. The position serves as a bridge between traditional broadcast engineering and modern IT-centric workflows, bringing a forward-looking perspective on emerging technologies, risks, and opportunities.

Nebraska Public Media offers a full spectrum of communications services to the citizens of Nebraska, the nation and the world. Some of these services include a nine-station, statewide noncommercial public television network affiliated with PBS ; a nine-station, statewide noncommercial public radio network affiliated with NPR ; a cutting-edge Digital Media Group; and state-of-the-art audio, video and multimedia production capability delivered via broadcast, satellite, cable, Internet and broadband delivery channels.

Minimum Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in broadcast engineering, IT, computer science, or related field and five (5) years’ experience in broadcast engineering or technology origination within the media or comparable industry.
Additional years of relevant experience or completed relevant education may substitute for required education/experience on a year-for-year basis.
Two (2) years’ experience in supervisory or team leadership, or functional supervision.
Strong working knowledge of IP-based media standards such as SMPTE ST-2110, PTP timing, AES67, and networked audio/video production.
Ability to evaluate emerging technologies and translate technical capabilities into practical, strategic recommendations that support long-term operational, financial, and organizational goals.
Ability to lead, mentor, and develop technical leaders, promote accountability through management structures, and foster a positive, high-performing team culture.
Ability to provide operational oversight of complex broadcast and distribution systems, including establishing performance expectations, assessing risk, and resolving escalated technical or operational issues.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical staff, executive leadership, and external stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

Seven (7) years’ experience in broadcast engineering or technology origination within the media or comparable industry.
Five (5) years of supervisory or team leadership experience.
Advanced knowledge of broadcast origination, master control, production, streaming, transmission, and digital distribution systems.
FCC Radiotelephone Operator’s License

$82,000/year minimum

Life at Starwood Hotels is based on a simple idea: the world is beautiful and we want to keep it that way. But we can’t do it alone. Our Company

Treehouse Hotels brings back the wonder of childhood hideaways—cozy, curious, and just a little mischievous. It’s a place to play, dream, and drift off the script, where handcrafted details and nostalgic touches turn every stay into a story.

If you’re ready to bring your whole self to a team where thoughtful work leaves a lasting mark—you belong here.

Starwood Hotels is seeking an exceptional Corporate Director, Engineering, to lead engineering operations and capital planning across the company’s portfolio of operating luxury and lifestyle hotels. This senior leadership role sits at the intersection of asset stewardship, hotel operations, capital investment, building systems, sustainability, and guest experience — responsible for ensuring that each property is safe, resilient, efficient, well maintained, and positioned to protect long-term asset value.

Reporting directly to SVP, Operations, the Corporate Director of Engineering, will oversee a global portfolio of 1 Hotels, Baccarat Hotels and Treehouse Hotels. As the company's project portfolio grows across multiple continents, this role will be pivotal in standardizing processes, resolving escalations and mentoring regional leaders.

The Corporate Director of Engineering will establish the portfolio-wide engineering framework for operating hotels while partnering closely with property General Managers, Directors of Engineering, ownership groups, Finance, Operations, Design & Construction, Sustainability, IT, Security, and other corporate functions. The role will provide technical leadership for annual and multi-year CAPEX planning, major renovations and infrastructure replacements, preventive maintenance, utility performance, regulatory compliance, and critical building-system reliability.

Required

Qualifications & Experience

Minimum 15 years of progressive engineering, facilities, asset management, or technical operations experience, with substantial leadership responsibility in luxury or upper-upscale hospitality.
Demonstrated experience overseeing engineering operations and capital programs across multiple operating hotels or similarly complex, 24/7 assets.
Deep working knowledge of central HVAC plants, controls/BMS, electrical distribution, emergency power, plumbing and domestic hot water, vertical transportation, fire/life safety, building envelope, kitchens, laundry, pools/spas, and other hotel building systems.
Proven ability to develop and prioritize multi-year CAPEX plans, evaluate asset conditions, build business cases, manage project budgets, and communicate investment recommendations to senior leadership and ownership groups.
Strong understanding of preventive/predictive maintenance, commissioning, equipment lifecycle planning, utility management, and root-cause failure analysis.
Experience managing projects in occupied hotels while minimizing disruption to guests, hotel operations, revenue, and brand experience.
Strong commercial judgment, executive communication skills, and ability to navigate owner, operator, vendor, and property leadership relationships.
Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, Electrical, Facilities, or another relevant Engineering discipline, or equivalent combination of technical education and significant hospitality engineering leadership experience.
Ability to travel regularly to operating hotels and respond to critical portfolio issues when required.

Preferred

Professional Engineer (PE), Certified Energy Manager (CEM), LEED AP, Certified Facility Manager (CFM), or comparable technical credential.
Experience with multiple luxury and lifestyle hotel brands, ownership structures, and management agreements.
Experience with hotel acquisitions, property-condition assessments, conversions, major renovations, and post-opening stabilization.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Package Design Engineering
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Sr. Director, Technical Program Management will lead a global technical program management organization responsible for driving execution of strategic AI/Datacenter Infrastructure Power package engineering and new product introduction (NPI) programs. This leader will partner closely with Package Engineering Directors, Power product group partners—especially Design, Application, and Marketing teams—Product, Reliability, Quality, Operations, Supply Chain, and key OSAT/CM partners to ensure programs meet committed schedules, quality and reliability objectives, and production readiness requirements. The role will establish strong program governance, identify and escalate critical risks early, and lead cross-functional technical task forces to resolve development challenges that threaten quality, reliability, yield, manufacturability, or schedule.

The organization will also provide technical program management leadership at key OSATs, ensuring consistent execution, issue escalation, and alignment between Renesas development teams and external assembly partners.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Lead the global Technical Program Management (TPM) organization supporting AI/Datacenter Infrastructure Power NPI and package engineering programs.

Partner with Package Engineering Directors who lead technical package development programs, providing program-level execution leadership, governance, and accountability.

Establish and drive end-to-end NPI program plans, milestones, critical paths, resource alignment, risk management, and executive reporting to ensure committed schedules are achieved.

Create a disciplined program management operating model covering development, qualification, customer requirements, production readiness, ramp, and transition to volume manufacturing.

Proactively identify technical, quality, reliability, supply, manufacturing, and schedule risks; establish mitigation plans and escalate critical issues with clear recommendations and decision points.

Lead cross-functional technical task forces for major development challenges, particularly issues affecting quality, reliability, yield, manufacturability, qualification, or NPI schedule.

Drive structured problem solving and closure of critical issues using data-driven methods, root-cause analysis, risk assessment, and clearly defined corrective/preventive actions.

Coordinate closely with Package Engineering, Power product group partners—especially Design, Application, and Marketing teams—Product Engineering, Reliability, Quality, Operations, Supply Chain, and other functional leaders to remove execution barriers and maintain program momentum.

Establish program dashboards and management systems that provide transparent visibility to milestones, critical path activities, risks, issues, action owners, and recovery plans.

Lead technical program management activities with key OSAT/CM partners, including program reviews, milestone tracking, issue escalation, recovery plans, qualification readiness, and production ramp execution.

Ensure execution of Engineering Build Requests (EBRs) per committed schedule at each OSAT, regularly tracking overall EBR progress, identifying delays, and driving timely recovery actions.

Develop and lead TPM teams located at strategic OSATs, ensuring alignment with Renesas priorities, technical teams, and global NPI schedules.

Ensure OSAT/CM development activities, DOE, process optimization, qualification, process-window verification, production controls, and ramp readiness are aligned with overall NPI program objectives.

Drive timely resolution of process integration and assembly issues that could impact product quality, reliability, qualification, yield, or customer commitments.

Ensure effective transition from development and qualification into production, including readiness reviews, ramp monitoring, issue management, and sustained execution.

Establish standardized program management processes, templates, metrics, escalation mechanisms, and lessons-learned practices across the global organization.

Provide concise, fact-based executive communication on program health, critical risks, schedule recovery, resource needs, and decisions required from senior leadership.

Build strong relationships with OSAT/CM executive and technical leadership to improve responsiveness, accountability, and execution of critical AI/Datacenter Power programs.

Develop the technical and leadership capabilities of the TPM organization and establish a high-performance, execution-focused culture.

Support package technology roadmap execution by translating strategic technology priorities into executable development programs, milestones, resources, and deliverables.

Address internal and external customer-impacting issues in partnership with Marketing, Product, Quality, Operations, and Package Engineering organizations.

LEADERSHIP & ORGANIZATIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES

Lead and develop a global team of Technical Program Managers supporting strategic AI/Datacenter Infrastructure Power programs.

Set organizational priorities, staffing strategy, performance expectations, and development plans aligned with business growth.

Establish clear accountability between Technical Program Managers and Package Engineering technical leaders while avoiding duplication of technical ownership.

Create a culture of urgency, fact-based decision making, cross-functional collaboration, ownership, and rapid issue resolution.

Drive consistent execution standards across internal teams and strategic OSAT locations.

Qualifications

QUALIFICATIONS

Doctorate, Master’s, or Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, Chemistry, or a related technical discipline.

15–20+ years of relevant experience in semiconductor engineering, product development, applications, package development, NPI, manufacturing, technical program management, or a closely related field.

Demonstrated experience leading complex semiconductor NPI programs involving package development, assembly, qualification, reliability, and manufacturing ramp.

Strong understanding of semiconductor product development process, package and assembly processes.

Experience in Power Management products, particularly power SiP/modules, Smart Power Stages, Vertical Power Stages, Power Modules, Discrete FET packages, battery management system, PMICs, wafer-level and/or flip-chip technologies.

Experience working with OSATs/CMs and managing complex development and production activities across geographically distributed organizations.

Proven track record leading cross-functional technical task forces and resolving complex issues involving quality, reliability, yield, manufacturability, and schedule.

Strong understanding of qualification, reliability, SPC/statistical methods, process development, risk management, and structured problem-solving methodologies.

Exceptional program management skills, including critical-path management, risk management, executive escalation, schedule recovery, and cross-functional resource alignment.

Strong interpersonal, communication, negotiation, and executive presentation skills.

Ability to influence senior technical and business leaders without direct authority and drive accountability across organizational boundaries.

Experience building and leading global teams, including teams in product groups, embedded at external manufacturing or OSAT locations.

Strong analytical skills and ability to translate complex technical issues into clear business impact, decisions, and actions.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Experience supporting high-growth customer programs.

Experience with Smart Power Stage, Vertical Power Stage, power module, discrete FET, SiC/GaN, DBC/AMB, multi-chip, wafer-level, or advanced interconnect technologies.

Experience with formal technical program management methodologies and portfolio-level governance.

Experience driving customer-critical NPI programs in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

SUCCESS MEASURES

On-time achievement of NPI milestones and customer commitments.

Reduction in schedule delays caused by unresolved technical, quality, reliability, or manufacturing issues.

Timely closure of critical cross-functional task-force actions.

Improved qualification, yield, reliability, and production-readiness performance.

Effective execution and alignment of strategic OSAT/CM partners.

Development of a high-performing global TPM organization and standardized program-management operating model.

Additional Information

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, To Make Our Lives Easier
. With a global team of over 21,000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‑leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future.

At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives.

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.

Are you ready to join our team and shape the future
with us?

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager - Custody
jobs.description:
In 1968, the New York Stock Exchange began closing on Wednesdays so brokerage firms could catch up on paperwork. Every transaction depended on physical stock certificates being delivered, recorded, and reconciled. Trading had outgrown the infrastructure behind it. The expression “Paperwork crisis” had entered the nation's agenda resulting in other temporary measures like shortened trading days and extending settlement. The industry responded with electronic clearing systems and the establishment of the Depository Trust & Clearing Corporation (DTCC) laying the foundation for markets that could operate at an entirely different scale.

Every share needs an identity, every movement needs a record, and every balance needs to agree with the institutions holding the assets. The best financial infrastructure makes this complexity feel ordinary. Building it takes extraordinary care.

At Mercury, our Investments team helps founders put their capital to work through products like Treasury and Invest. Our Custody team builds the systems underneath that experience: the ledger, security master service, reconciliation, and operational tools that keep customer assets accurately accounted for and give our products a dependable foundation to grow.

We’re looking for a senior engineering manager to lead the Custody team through its next stages of growth and scale to better serve our small and large customers.

As part of this role, you will:

Lead, hire, and develop a team of senior engineers, providing thoughtful feedback and building a trusting and supportive environment.
Own the team’s technical strategy and roadmap, translating Mercury’s investment ambitions into focused priorities and predictable delivery.
Guide the design and evolution of core custody systems, including cash and securities ledgers, security master service, position tracking, and reconciliation.
Partner with product, investment operations, and compliance to turn business and regulatory requirements into well-designed systems, operational controls, and auditable workflows that balance correctness, scale, and maintainability.
Collaborate with Product and Partnerships to align integrations, responsibilities, and technical roadmaps.
Set a high bar for correctness, reliability, and incident response, balancing new capabilities with the maintenance and improvement of critical systems.

The ideal candidate for the role:

Has 3+ years of experience managing highly technical teams.
Has direct experience building or operating RIA and broker-dealer custody systems at scale, including ledgers, security master service, cash and securities reconciliation, and money movement.
Understands the broker-dealer operating model and how responsibilities and data flow across introducing brokers, clearing firms, and custodians.
Has worked closely with compliance and operations teams, translating requirements into practical engineering decisions and effective controls.
Understands the lifecycle of securities and the implications of settlement and corporate actions for customer cash and positions across equities, fixed income, ETFs, and mutual funds.

If this role interests you, we invite you to explore our public demo at demo.mercury.com/accounts/treasury.

San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States

In 1968, the New York Stock Exchange began closing on Wednesdays so brokerage firms could catch up on paperwork. Every transaction depended on physical stock certificates being delivered, recorded, and reconciled. Trading had outgrown the infrastructure behind it. The expression “Paperwork crisis” had entered the nation's agenda resulting in other temporary measures like shortened trading days and extending settlement. The industry responded with electronic clearing systems and the establishment of the Depository Trust & Clearing Corporation (DTCC) laying the foundation for markets that could operate at an entirely different scale.

Every share needs an identity, every movement needs a record, and every balance needs to agree with the institutions holding the assets. The best financial infrastructure makes this complexity feel ordinary. Building it takes extraordinary care.

At Mercury, our Investments team helps founders put their capital to work through products like Treasury and Invest. Our Custody team builds the systems underneath that experience: the ledger, security master service, reconciliation, and operational tools that keep customer assets accurately accounted for and give our products a dependable foundation to grow.

We’re looking for a senior engineering manager to lead the Custody team through its next stages of growth and scale to better serve our small and large customers.

Lead, hire, and develop a team of senior engineers, providing thoughtful feedback and building a trusting and supportive environment.
Own the team’s technical strategy and roadmap, translating Mercury’s investment ambitions into focused priorities and predictable delivery.
Guide the design and evolution of core custody systems, including cash and securities ledgers, security master service, position tracking, and reconciliation.
Partner with product, investment operations, and compliance to turn business and regulatory requirements into well-designed systems, operational controls, and auditable workflows that balance correctness, scale, and maintainability.
Collaborate with Product and Partnerships to align integrations, responsibilities, and technical roadmaps.
Set a high bar for correctness, reliability, and incident response, balancing new capabilities with the maintenance and improvement of critical systems.

Has 3+ years of experience managing highly technical teams.

Understands the broker-dealer operating model and how responsibilities and data flow across introducing brokers, clearing firms, and custodians.
Has worked closely with compliance and operations teams, translating requirements into practical engineering decisions and effective controls.
Understands the lifecycle of securities and the implications of settlement and corporate actions for customer cash and positions across equities, fixed income, ETFs, and mutual funds.

jobs.title: Founding Head of Product & Engineering
jobs.description:
SYNDRI | New York City preferred | Full-time

About SYNDRI

SYNDRI is the world’s first consumer-facing AI jewelry designer. Customers can design custom fine jewelry through conversation, starting with an idea, image, reference or existing piece. They can explore and refine the design visually, send it to pricing, approve the final design and CAD and 3D imaging and have the piece produced by skilled jewelers.

SYNDRI is currently in private beta. The core product is built and we are now focused on refining the experience, expanding the product roadmap and preparing to scale.

We’re looking for our first senior product hire to own that next phase.

The Role

As Founding Head of Product & Engineering, you will work directly with the founder and take ownership of both the product experience and the technical evolution of SYNDRI.

There is a significant roadmap ahead. Your job is to make the product dramatically better: refine the existing experience, decide what should be built next, improve the underlying AI systems and execute quickly.

This is not a traditional Head of Product role where you primarily manage a roadmap and hand requirements to engineers. You should be technical enough to work directly in the product yourself — understanding the codebase, prototyping and implementing improvements, evaluating models and APIs, debugging issues and making informed technical decisions.

You will have engineering support, but you will be the internal technical owner of the product. You should be comfortable getting hands-on yourself whenever that is the fastest or best way to solve a problem.

At the same time, this is not a pure engineering role. You will think deeply about the customer, product experience, roadmap and business - and make decisions about what is worth building in the first place.

SYNDRI sits at the intersection of AI, consumer product, design, ecommerce and physical production. The software needs to feel creative and intuitive while ultimately producing a real object that can be priced, manufactured and delivered. A major part of the opportunity is figuring out how more of that journey can become intelligent, automated and scalable over time.

What You'll Own

Product strategy, roadmap and prioritization
The technical direction and evolution of the SYNDRI product
The end-to-end customer experience, from first idea through finished commission
Refining and expanding the existing core product
Improving the quality, reliability and intelligence of the AI design experience
Evaluating and integrating new models, APIs and AI capabilities
Prototyping and implementing product improvements directly when appropriate
Developing intelligent workflows across conversation, imagery, structured product information, pricing and production
Improving how information moves between generated designs and downstream systems
Identifying opportunities to automate currently manual parts of the design-to-production process
Product QA, user testing, experimentation and analytics
Debugging product issues and solving edge cases quickly
Making pragmatic technical decisions about what to build internally, what to automate and what to use third-party tools for
Working with engineering support on larger or more specialized builds
Eventually helping build the product and engineering organization as SYNDRI grows

Who We're Looking For

You are an ambitious, highly technical builder who wants to move fast, solve hard problems and take real ownership in building something meaningful at scale.

You have:
Significant experience building and shipping technology products, ideally with meaningful 0→1 or early-stage ownership
Strong product judgment and an exceptional instinct for consumer experience
Strong technical fluency and the ability to work directly with an existing product and codebase
Hands-on experience building with modern AI models, APIs and generative AI systems
Experience working with LLMs, image models, multimodal systems, structured outputs or related AI technologies
The ability to prototype and implement product ideas yourself rather than relying on engineers for every iteration
Enough engineering depth to debug problems, evaluate technical approaches and make sound architecture decisions
An understanding of APIs, databases, data structures and modern web applications
Comfort working across text, images and structured data
The ability to think through how complex human workflows can progressively become software-driven or automated
Experience working closely with engineers and knowing when something should be built yourself versus handed to a specialist
The ability to move quickly through ambiguity and turn ideas into working product
A willingness to be extremely hands-on - testing outputs, building prototypes, reviewing flows, talking to customers and digging into edge cases yourself
Excellent written and verbal communication

Experience in consumer AI, multimodal AI, creative tools, e-commerce, marketplaces, computational design or software connecting digital experiences to physical products is particularly relevant.
Jewelry experience is not required, but a genuine understanding of or interest in fine jewelry would be a major plus.

You'll Probably Love This Role If:

You want to be close to both the customer and the technology.
You like figuring out problems that do not already have an obvious solution.
You want to spend more time building, testing and solving than managing process.
You enjoy moving between a product decision, an AI experiment, a technical problem and a customer experience without treating them as separate jobs.
You want significant ownership and want to join early enough that your decisions shape both the product and the technical foundation of the company.

Location

New York City preferred.
We are open to exceptional candidates elsewhere in the U.S., but this role will work extremely closely with the founder and will be a core member of the founding team.

Compensation

$200,000–$250,000 base salary + meaningful early-stage equity, depending on experience and technical depth.

To Apply

If this sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend the next few years solving, we’d love to hear from you.

Please send your LinkedIn or resume along with a few sentences about something you personally built.

We’d especially like to understand a product or technical problem where you had to figure out both what the right solution was and how to make it work.

If relevant, include links to products, prototypes, GitHub projects or other work that helps us understand how you build.

We care much less about polished cover letters than about understanding what you personally owned, built and shipped.

jobs.title: Senior Transportation Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Hanson Values

Integrity | Commitment | Quality | Relationships | Innovation

If you’re looking for a firm that encourages innovative thinking and challenges you every day, with an opportunity to learn and advance, a career at Hanson is right for you. The belief in sustainability within our company’s practices creates a focus on client success and partnerships that are important to our communities and our environment.

A Day in the Life of a Senior Transportation Engineering Manager at Hanson

By joining our Chicago Loop, Lisle, or Peoria office in this role, you will:

Step into a leading role on major Hanson projects in Illinois, such as the Tollway I-355/I-88 Interchange master planning project near Chicago and the IDOT I-80 Mississippi River Bridge replacement and interchange reconstruction project between Illinois and Iowa.
Provide day-to-day leadership, workload coordination, and technical direction for an assigned group of engineers and technical staff.
Serve as project engineer on complex transportation assignments, coordinating disciplines and subconsultants, managing design activities, supporting schedules, and reviewing team deliverables.
Coach and mentor staff through regular feedback, career discussions, technical guidance, stretch assignments, and performance reviews.
Forecast short- and long-term staffing needs by evaluating backlog, anticipated pursuits, resource availability, capability gaps, and hiring requirements.
Develop roadway design solutions for complex interstate, tollway, urban arterial, highway, and local road improvement projects.
Direct the development of construction plans and contract documents. Author technical documents such as engineering reports and special provisions.
Guide roadway design teams using OpenRoads Designer, supported by internal training resources and active user groups.
Review complex technical calculations, reports, plans, and deliverables.
Lead or support client relationships, pursuits, scopes, fees, and proposals.
Provide occasional support for public involvement activities.
Travel occasionally for client meetings and site visits.
Perform other related duties as assigned.

What We’re Looking For

The following qualifications will help you succeed in this role:

Skills

Illinois DOT/Tollway planning, design, plan production, and PS&E experience.
Working knowledge of roadway design software such as OpenRoads Designer.
Familiarity with OpenRoads Designer 3D modeling for roadway projects is a plus.
Interest in continued learning, professional growth, and expanding technical and leadership skills.
Experience supervising, mentoring, or formally leading engineers and technical staff.
Strong technical judgment, problem-solving ability, organization, and attention to detail.
Experience leading or supporting quality control reviews to ensure adherence with industry and client design standards.
Excellent communication and teamwork skills.

Education/Experience

Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering is required.
Typically 10+ years of professional engineering experience.
Minimum of six years of roadway design or transportation engineering experience, including work for IDOT and/or the Illinois Tollway.
Illinois Professional Engineer license, or the ability to obtain an Illinois license through reciprocity within six months of hire.

Salary range: $150,000 – $190,000 per year. Compensation will be based on experience, technical qualifications, and overall fit for the role. This position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus.

Benefits

Our focus on people means we offer a generous benefits program to help you create a solid foundation for health and security throughout your career, including:

Competitive compensation
Performance bonuses
401(k) with matching contribution
Employee Stock Ownership Plan
Comprehensive health & well-being plans
Financial wellness plans
Work-life balance programs

Want to know more? Visit our benefits page for all the details.

Culture

About

We understand that selecting a job is about more than the day-to-day tasks. It’s important to feel like you belong and safe to grow and progress along your career path. You’ll find that at Hanson. We have an inclusive, diverse workforce awaiting to connect with you and numerous opportunities to cultivate your career, including:

Monthly educational webinars
Leadership training
Lunch & learn development sessions
24/7 access to thousands of skill-building courses
Mentorship opportunities
Award-winning internship program
Employee recognition
And so much more!

jobs.title: Director of Engineering and Documentation
jobs.description:
Description

TITLE:
Director of Engineering and Documentation

Reports To:
President

Supervise:
Documentation Supervisor and Engineers

Job Summary

This role provides strategic leadership and oversight for the sustainability engineering functions and documentation and configuration management. Guiding and directing a documentation and a team of engineers. This role is accountable for the sustainability engineering and full documentation disciplines — from tactical execution quality to long-term strategic direction. This role also partners closely with senior leadership, program management, and key stakeholders to align sustainability of product adoptions within business growth objectives, drives enterprise-wide process transformation initiatives, and ensures the organization meets its highest standards for compliance, data integrity, and operational excellence. Supports the interaction between engineering, manufacturing operations, and program management. This role requires the vision to see the future state, the credibility to influence it, and the execution discipline to deliver it.

COMPLEXITY & PROBLEM SOLVING

Works on issues where analysis of situations or data requires conceptual thinking and an in-depth knowledge of organizational objectives. Problems are not clearly defined and lack strategic direction. Implements policies and select methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria for obtaining results. Drives the strategy and success of larger projects which contribute to multiple areas of the organization.

This role may also work on complex issues where problems are not clearly defined and where fundamental principles do not fully apply. Translates business segment strategy into functional plans and guides execution. Participates in corporate development of methods, techniques and evaluation criteria for projects, programs, and people. Ensures budgets (partial) and schedules meet corporate requirements.

SCOPE OF MANGEMENT & SUPERVISION

Manages activities of two or more disciplines within a department. Oversee experienced level professionals and/or may be responsible for subordinate supervisors. Frequently advises team(s) on moderately complex matters. Accountable for department budget which may be broad and have far reaching impact on the business segment. Directs the activities of a functional areas through team and team supervisor. Leads team(s) to develop new methods and solve complex matters.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Organizational Development

Define and execute the multi-year documentation and configuration management strategy, aligning functional capabilities with the organization's growth, quality, and compliance objectives.
Build a culture of excellence, ownership, and continuous improvement that attracts and retains top documentation talent.
Lead, mentor, and develop a team of engineers and technical staff, providing regular feedback, career guidance, and professional development opportunities
Serve as a key contributor to department strategy development, translating organizational goals into actionable team objectives and initiatives
Ability to think and draw conclusions quickly, adapt to change, be open to new ideas, take on new responsibilities, handle pressure, and adjust plans and priorities to meet changing needs
Plans for and uses resources efficiently, looks for ways to reduce costs, creates accurate and realistic budgets, tracks and adjusts budgets, contributes to budget planning
Effectively communicate project expectations to project team members and stakeholders in a timely and clear fashion.
Facilitate the definition of project goals, tasks, and resource requirements; resolve or assist in the resolution of conflicts within and between projects or functional areas; develop methods to monitor project progress

Enterprise Documentation & Configuration Management

The document control focus specializes in implementing and maintaining an engineering change notice system. These changes will include product improvements, obsolescence management and product development.
Own enterprise documentation standards, policies, and governance frameworks applicable across all programs, sites, and customers.
Drive cross-site configuration management maturity — establishing consistent CMP frameworks, CCB governance models, and CM audit cadences.
Serve as the organization's senior escalation point for the most complex documentation, change control, and configuration disputes requiring executive engagement.
Lead the documentation function through major organizational events — ERP migrations, PLM platform transitions, new site launches, or large program onboards.
Ensures all contractual requirements pertaining to configuration management are implemented and followed on a given program.

Customer, Program & Executive Engagement

Represent the documentation function at the executive and customer level, participating in program reviews, contract negotiations, and strategic planning sessions.
Build and maintain trusted relationships with key customers, serving as the senior point of contact for documentation-related performance, corrective action, and capability discussions.
Translate customer and market requirements into functional capability investments and process improvements.
Collaborate with product/program managers and cross-functional teams to identify customer needs, allocate resources, and deliver projects on schedule and budget

ITAR, Compliance & Risk Management

Own the enterprise ITAR compliance posture for the documentation function; ensure Technical Data Control Plans, training programs, and audit processes are current, effective, and audit-ready at all times.
Identify and manage documentation-related compliance risks across the enterprise; develop mitigation strategies and present risk posture to executive leadership.
Maintain current knowledge of evolving ITAR/EAR regulations, AS9102 standards, and CMMC requirements; proactively adapt organizational practices accordingly.
Ensure compliance with industry standards, local regulations, and safety requirements.
Reviews audit information and guides audits of systems to verify the baseline documentation is accurate and complete. Obtains customer acceptance of baseline documentation through formal configuration verifications and audits, such as functional configuration and physical configuration audits.

Technology & Process Transformation

Lead enterprise-level PLM and ERP transformation initiatives, from strategy definition through implementation governance and adoption measurement.
Champion digital transformation of documentation workflows including paperless manufacturing, and AI-assisted document processing.
Establish enterprise KPIs, benchmarks, and maturity models for the documentation function; report on progress to the executive team.
Build technical depth across the sustainment engineering staff through targeted training, knowledge sharing, and hands-on mentoring in in various engineering disciplines.
Ability to conceptualize initial component and system designs with schematics and block diagrams; lead project team execution of assembly, test, debug, and optimization; and organizing results for design reviews and customer presentations.
Provide technical leadership and hands-on contributions across the sustainment engineering lifecycle, including concept development, design, test, and integration activities
Experience designing and developing engineering solutions to overcome component obsolescence
Ensures validation of engineering drawings, specifications, contract deliverables, various software documentation, contract modifications, and design release documents to confirm compliance with customer contract requirements.

Requirements

MINIMUM EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE

Must be a U.S. Person as defined under 22 C.F.R.
120.15 (U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident, or protected individual) due to access to ITAR-controlled technical data.
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technical Management, Business Administration, or a related field; or equivalent work experience.
12+ years of progressive experience in documentation control, configuration management, or related technical management within EMS, PCBA, or defense/aerospace manufacturing, including 5+ years managing managers or multi-site teams.
Strong knowledge of ITAR, NIST-800 and relevant compliance regulations as they relate to the business objectives.
Strong understanding of AS9100, IPC standards, and PCBA manufacturing processes — sufficient to set enterprise-wide standards and make authoritative decisions.
Demonstrated ownership and strategic direction of enterprise PLM and ERP systems across multiple programs or sites.
Strong configuration management authority — CMP development, multi-site CCB governance, and strong working knowledge in relevance to Defense Manufacturing.
Strong communication across leadership levels and team development.
Experienced business acumen —managing departmental budgets and building business cases.
Experience in a leadership role, communicating with and influencing stakeholders at all levels.
Working knowledge of contract requirements identification, engineering design documentation, and build and test processes
Proficient written and verbal communication skills to allow effective communication with both technical and non-technical teams
Critical thinking, analytical, able to draw conclusions quickly, open to new ideas, take on new responsibilities, handle pressure, and adjust plans and priorities to changing needs.

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree in Engineering Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
CMII certification or equivalent senior compliance credential.
PMP or equivalent program management certification.
Experience with CMMC Level 2/3 documentation requirements and CUI handling.
Track record of leading enterprise PLM or ERP platform transitions.
Experience building documentation functions at new manufacturing sites or during major business integrations.
Willingness to adapt, grow and work through challenges for continuous improvements within a maturing organization.

jobs.description:
About Re:Build
  At Re:Build, our mission is to ensure the next generation of important products are made, at scale, in America. We are laying the foundation for a better future for our customers, employees, and communities by revitalizing America's manufacturing base and creating meaningful jobs across the country, including in historically deindustrialized regions.  
We operate an advanced, end-to-end manufacturing platform that partners with industrial companies and innovators to take products from first concept to full-scale production in critical verticals including aerospace and defense, electrification, medical, energy and environment, and robotics and automation.  
The way we operate is as important as the work we do. It's guided by The Re:Build Way, 16 principles that shape how we collaborate with each other, partner with our customers and vendors, and contribute to the communities where we operate.  (link to  The Re:Build Way principles )  

Who we are looking for

The Director, Forward Deployed Engineering is a hands-on leadership role in Re:Build Manufacturing's Digital Innovation Group (DIG). This role reflects the organization’s belief that digital innovation is key to scaling as a premier industrial company. jobs.title: Director, Software Engineering
jobs.description:
About You

You are driven to transform healthcare through software and believe that primary care, when powered by the right technology, can deliver dramatically better outcomes at lower cost. You are motivated by solving messy, real-world problems and turning them into scalable, elegant systems.

You operate with high ownership and high judgment. You are as comfortable writing production code as you are making architectural tradeoffs and prioritization decisions alongside business leaders. You thrive in ambiguity, move quickly, and care deeply about building things that actually work in the hands of end users.

You are not just an engineering leader. You are a builder, a systems thinker, and a partner to the business.

Who We Are

Oasis Health Partners (Oasis) is building healthier communities by advancing primary care.

We partner with patients, providers, and plans to provide personalized, local care for seniors. We believe that patient needs come first, and that primary care is the foundation of patient-centric healthcare. With Oasis, patients receive better access and care. Providers receive the data, resources, and expertise to be successful in value-based care arrangements. Payors get the benefit of a solution that improves performance, drives growth, and reduces the total cost of care in hard-to-engage markets.

Together, we will boldly advance primary care for those that need it most. We are excited for you to join us on this journey. We invite you to be a part of Oasis, where you will discover we listen first, do the right thing, build things together and go all in, while having fun!

Your Role

The Director, Software Engineering will report to the Vice President of Software Engineering and help build, operate, and scale our software engineering organization and technology platform. This is a hands-on, builder-first role. Initially, you should expect to spend ~80% of your time writing code, designing systems, and standing up core infrastructure. Over time, you will help hire and lead a small, high-leverage team, but this is not a traditional management-heavy role. We are intentionally building a lean engineering team and are looking for a player-coach who enjoys staying close to the technology while providing technical and operational leadership.

Today’s value-based care (VBC) infrastructure is fragmented, reactive, and not built for the realities of modern care delivery. Providers are underserved by legacy tools that fail to integrate data, workflows, and decision-making in meaningful ways. Oasis is building a modern, AI-native platform to change that.

You will partner closely with the VP of Software Engineering and work alongside Product, Data Engineering, and Security to help define and build Oasis’ next-generation provider enablement platform, including core application architecture, data integration strategy, and AI-native capabilities.

Core Expectations

Technical Leadership & Architecture

Partner with the VP of Software Engineering on architecture and technology strategy, staying hands-on in design, code review, and technical decisions
Evolve the architecture as the platform grows, and manage technical debt before it becomes a barrier
Set pragmatic standards that balance scalability, security, maintainability, delivery speed, and cost

AI-Native Product Development

Use AI-assisted development tools and agentic workflows to materially increase engineering velocity
Embed AI directly into provider workflows (documentation, decision support, care coordination), building systems where AI is foundational, not additive

Cloud, DevSecOps & Platform Operations

Own the reliability, security, and operation of the AWS platform, including infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, and QA automation
Establish monitoring, observability, SLOs/RTOs/RPOs, and incident response practices
Build runbooks so critical platform knowledge isn't siloed on one person

Business Translation & Team Building

Work directly with clinical, operations, and growth teams to turn ambiguous real-world processes into scalable products, prioritized by ROI
Recruit and develop a small, high-performing engineering team, setting a high bar for quality, speed, and ownership

Key Responsibilities

The provider enablement platform, including patient- and provider-facing applications
Integrations across multiple EMRs and external data sources
Secure, compliant architecture aligned to HIPAA, SOC 2, and HITRUST
Engineering execution: roadmap translation, milestone planning, and delivery

In Your First 12 Months, You Will

Contribute to the architecture and launch core components of Oasis’ provider platform
Implement initial QA automation, observability, and operational solutions and workflows
Contribute to agentic SDLC operations, maturing our use of AI to deliver high quality, maintainable software
Deliver production-grade patient and provider-facing applications
Implement initial AI-powered workflows within provider operations
Establish foundational engineering standards, infrastructure, and development velocity

What We’re Looking For

Required:

10+ years of software engineering experience
4+ years in a technical leadership role (player-coach strongly preferred)
Proven track record of personally building and delivering production systems
Demonstrated experience using AI-powered solutions (i.e.: Claude Code) to deliver quality software solutions to production in a highly regulated environment
Demonstrated experience applying LLMs and/or agentic workflows in real-world applications
Deep expertise in AWS and modern cloud architecture
Strong full-stack experience (e.g., React/Angular + Node.js/TypeScript or similar)
Proficiency in Python and SQL
Experience designing APIs and integrating with complex external systems

Strongly Preferred:

Experience building QA automation and reporting solutions
Experience building SRE solutions
Experience building healthcare or provider-facing applications
Experience working in HIPAA / SOC 2 / HITRUST environments
Background in startup or high-growth environments

Investment in Our Team

We invest deeply in our team’s success; personally, and professionally. We offer comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), and generous time off.
More importantly, you’ll be part of a mission-driven team building something that matters - alongside people who are deeply committed to improving care for seniors.

Why This Role Matters

This is a high-conviction, high-investment hire for Oasis.
We are making a deliberate bet on building differentiated, AI-native technology as a core driver of our success, and this role is central to that strategy.
If you are looking to help define the technical foundation of a company, not just contribute to it, this is that opportunity.

Salary Range: $159,000 USD - $200,000 USD

The salary range listed reflects the full compensation range for this role level at Oasis and is designed to support growth over time. Actual offers may vary based on a candidate’s skills, experience, and alignment with the scope of the role. Offers near the top of the range are uncommon and generally reflect exceptionally deep, directly relevant experience.

FIRST ROUND OF APPLICATION REVIEW WILL BE ON AUGUST 25, 2026

The Technology and Innovation Director (TID) supports the County and its partners by providing effective leadership of information technology resources that maintain stable, dependable business applications, as well as an information technology environment that ensures efficient delivery of service to supported entities and the public. The TID also provides strategic leadership to the County and its partners, focusing more on enterprise, strategic efforts. The TID focuses on the people, processes, projects, and technology as a seamless system designed to achieve the mutual interests of the entire system. The TID reports to the County Manager’s Office and serves as the primary advisor on all technology initiatives that are most relevant to the county goals and evolving needs, as well as evaluates their impact on work processes. Performs work with independent judgement. Oversees assigned departments and operations, develops courses of action and recommendations.

Essential Functions

Provides leadership, management, and strategic direction to the County and its partners, ensuring that their priorities are aligned with the overall goals of the entity. Exercises authority regarding all hardware, software, and services utilized by the County and its partners.
Develops enterprise-wide strategic and multiyear action plans, and financial forecasts in the furtherance of these objectives.
Develops and implements policies/programs for the procurement and use of technology hardware, software, and services.
Provides supervision, guidance, training, and motivation to assigned personnel; determines and coordinates work procedures and schedules; assigns, monitors and reviews work; evaluates performance, and initiates corrective action, as needed.
Serves as the primary technical advisor proposing short-term and long-term solutions to technology management needs/issues relating to systems, equipment or services. Carries out management direction as given.
Collaborates, coordinates and communicates with the County and its partner’s management regarding their business needs and emerging technology expectations. Facilitates the decision-making processes and prioritization of IT projects amongst entities.
Works closely with organizational decision makers to identify, recommend, develop, implement, and support cost-effective hardware and software solutions for the organizations assigned providing direction for strategic, budgetary, and operational plans for equipment, software programs, and services.
Ensures appropriate cybersecurity program is established and functional, including tested disaster recovery protocols are in place.
Identifies and implements collaborative initiatives with other agencies to promote strategic endeavors and the effective/efficient provision of services.
Train and cross-train all department staff to increase department knowledge, build redundancy for absences/emergencies, and plan for advancement and succession. Must set the bar high for customer-oriented, collaborative culture.
Prepares and presents the Department’s annual budget and assures continued compliance with the parameters of the adopted budget.
Interacts and effectively communicates with various groups and individuals such as County Manager, Board of County Commissioners, Constitutional Officers, other County employees, various other Local, State and Federal agencies, personnel in other jurisdictions, vendors, consultants, contractors, business/property owners and citizens.

Job Summary

DataXstream is seeking a visionary presales leader to serve as our Vice President of Presales Engineering — someone who can help define the future of a high-performing presales program. Reporting to the SVP of Sales, North America, and carrying global responsibility, this leader will lead, develop, and scale our presales organization while pioneering the integration of artificial intelligence across every stage of the presale lifecycle. This strategic player/coach role is responsible for building a world-class presales engineering team and for embedding AI into demonstrations, messaging, positioning, and solutioning to accelerate the sales cycle and deepen customer engagement.
The VP of Presales Engineering serves as a critical bridge between Sales, Product, and Marketing — supporting go-to-market (GTM) execution, championing DataXstream's Order Management capabilities across SAP ECC and S/4HANA, and channeling structured field feedback into the product roadmap. The ideal candidate combines deep SAP domain expertise, a track record of leading high-performing presales teams, and a forward-looking vision for how AI can transform the way enterprise software is demonstrated and sold.

Key Responsibilities

Lead, mentor, and grow the presales engineering organization, establishing the structure, processes, and career development paths that attract and retain top solution engineering talent.
Own the technical win: guide the team in delivering compelling, tailored demonstrations, proofs of concept, and solution architectures that clearly articulate DataXstream's value within the SAP ecosystem.
Drive the integration of AI into presales — embedding AI-powered capabilities and tooling into demos, messaging, positioning, and solutioning to differentiate DataXstream and shorten the path to value for prospects.
Position DataXstream's Order Management capabilities for both SAP ECC and S/4HANA, ensuring the team can credibly address customer requirements across current and migrating SAP landscapes.
Partner with Sales leadership to support go-to-market activities, including account strategy, deal pursuit, executive engagement, and the development of repeatable presales assets and playbooks.
Serve as the voice of the field to Product Management, capturing and prioritizing structured customer and prospect feedback to inform the product roadmap and future innovation.
Collaborate with Marketing to shape technical messaging, value propositions, and competitive positioning that resonate with SAP buyers and decisionmakers.
Define and track presales KPIs — such as technical win rate, demo effectiveness, and time-to-solution — and use data to continuously improve team performance and impact.
Represent DataXstream at customer meetings, industry events, and partner engagements as a credible technical and thought leader.
Ensure alignment between presales, delivery, and customer success so that what is sold is consistently and successfully implemented.

Required Qualifications

10+ years of experience in presales, solution engineering, or solution consulting, including 5+ years in a leadership role managing and developing presales or solution engineering teams.
Deep SAP experience is required, with demonstrated expertise in positioning Order Management capabilities across both SAP ECC and S/4HANA.
Proven ability to translate complex enterprise software capabilities into clear, business-focused value propositions for technical and executive audiences.
Demonstrated success supporting go-to-market and revenue objectives in a B2B enterprise software or SaaS environment.
Experience leveraging or integrating AI/GenAI into sales, presales, or product workflows — or a clear, credible vision and track record of applying emerging technology to drive results.
Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to influence customers, partners, and cross-functional stakeholders.
Experience establishing structured feedback loops between the field and product development.
Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Willingness to travel as required to support customer engagements and business needs.

Preferred Qualifications

Direct experience with SAP Order Management, order-to-cash, or customer service/counter-sales processes.
Familiarity with DataXstream's SAP market, or experience selling ISV or add-on solutions into the SAP ecosystem.
Hands-on experience implementing AI-driven demo automation, conversational AI, or intelligent solutioning tools.
Experience scaling a presales function during a period of rapid company growth.
SAP certifications or equivalent recognized credentials.
MBA or advanced degree.

jobs.description:
Description

This is an onsite position requiring the team member to be onsite 4 days a week, and 1 day remotely.

No relocation is provided for this opportunity.

At West, we’re a dedicated team that is connected by a purpose to improve patient lives that has been at the center of our Company for more than a century. Our story began when Herman O. West solved the problem of supplying penicillin in mass quantities to the US Government during World War 2. Through our work to deliver thousands of life-saving and life-enhancing injectable medicines to millions of patients daily, West’s indelible mark on the healthcare industry has just begun. A name started our story. How will yours help write our future?

There’s no better place to join an inclusive community of professionals with opportunities for lifelong learning, growth and development. Supported by benefit programs, we empower the physical, mental, emotional and financial health of our team members and their families.

We believe in giving back to help those in need in the communities where we live and work. And are equally committed to creating a healthier environment and planet through our sustainability efforts.

Job Summary

The Director of Computational Engineering & Engineering Sciences owns West's enterprise capability for predictive engineering. This role develops and applies engineering sciences, computational methods, simulation, and validated digital engineering methodologies that establish technical confidence, improve engineering decision quality, and reduce dependence on physical iteration throughout early technology evaluation, product engineering, manufacturing development, and customer technical collaboration.

The capability partners closely with Enterprise AI Strategy & Solutions, applying enterprise AI capabilities within engineering to strengthen predictive engineering, engineering methodologies, and engineering decision quality.

This role integrates structural analysis, fluid dynamics, Moldflow, metrology, computational modeling, analytical engineering, and predictive engineering into a unified enterprise capability supporting Central R&D, Operating Units, customers, and external technology partners.

Working across pre-development, Product Engineering, Manufacturing Development, Digital Platforms, and Operating Units, this role partners with engineering organizations to establish predictive engineering methodologies that improve technical confidence and engineering decision quality across the enterprise.

Success is measured by the organization's ability to establish reusable predictive engineering methodologies that improve engineering decision quality across multiple product platforms and engineering organizations.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Enterprise Predictive Engineering

Own West's enterprise Predictive Engineering capability
Serve as West's enterprise authority for predictive engineering, establishing methodologies, standards, and model validation practices that improve technical confidence and engineering decision quality across multiple engineering Organizations.
Establish engineering methodologies that improve technical confidence through predictive analysis prior to physical iteration.
Develop reusable predictive engineering methodologies supporting pre-development, product engineering, manufacturing development, and customer technical collaboration.
Establish enterprise standards governing computational engineering methods, simulation quality, and engineering model validation.

Predictive Engineering Applications

Develop enterprise predictive engineering methodologies supporting concept evaluation, technical risk reduction, and early product realization.
Lead application of structural mechanics, fluid dynamics, Moldflow, multiphysics simulation, optimization, and systems modeling throughout product development.
Expand predictive engineering practices supporting concept evaluation, feasibility, and product development through simulation, engineering sciences, and validated computational methods.
Improve engineering decision quality through predictive analysis and engineering trade studies.
Support architecture evaluation, engineering optimization, and technical risk reduction using computational methods.
Develop computational methodologies supporting customer collaboration on predictive evaluation of drug-device, drug-container, and material interaction.

Engineering Integration of Enterprise AI

Define engineering use cases and integrate enterprise AI capabilities into predictive engineering methodologies where they improve technical confidence, engineering productivity, and engineering decision quality.
Develop engineering methodologies that combine simulation, computational methods, and predictive engineering practices to accelerate technical learning and reduce engineering uncertainty.

Engineering Capability Development

Integrate Structural Engineering, Fluid Engineering, Moldflow, Metrology, Computational Modeling, and Analytical Engineering into a unified enterprise capability.
Develop engineering methodologies that reduce dependence on physical prototypes through validated predictive models.
Establish reusable predictive engineering methodologies, validated engineering models, and computational standards supporting multiple engineering organizations and product platforms.
Promote collaboration across pre-development, Product Engineering, Manufacturing Development, and Operating Units.

Additional Responsibilities

Organizational Leadership

Develop and grow West's Predictive Engineering capability through direct technical leadership, strategic partnerships, and selective capability expansion aligned with business demand.
Develop capability roadmaps, staffing recommendations, and investment strategies aligned with enterprise priorities and demonstrated business demand.
Promote continuous improvement in engineering methodologies supporting West's strategic growth platforms.
Ensure compliance with West quality systems and applicable regulatory requirements.
Build strategic relationships with pharmaceutical customers, software providers, universities, research organizations, and external technology partners to advance West’s enterprise predictive engineering capability.
Develop the long-term capability strategy for Predictive Engineering, including organization, technology, partnerships, and engineering methodology roadmaps.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, Engineering Science, or related discipline required. Master's degree preferred. Ph.D. desirable.

Work Experience

Minimum ten (10) years of engineering experience with significant emphasis on computational engineering, simulation, or predictive engineering.
Minimum seven (7) years of engineering leadership experience.
Demonstrated experience applying structural analysis, fluid dynamics, Moldflow, computational modeling, and engineering simulation to complex product development programs.
Experience establishing enterprise engineering methodologies or technical standards preferred.
Experience supporting regulated product development strongly preferred.
Experience collaborating with external customers or partners on predictive modeling, simulation, material interaction, or drug-container / drug-device technical evaluations preferred.
Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary analytical engineering organizations.
Experience applying enterprise AI capabilities within engineering simulation, optimization, or predictive engineering environments preferred.

Preferred Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

Expert knowledge of finite element analysis (FEA), computational fluid dynamics (CFD), Moldflow, optimization methods, and systems modeling.
Strong understanding of engineering sciences supporting regulated product development.
Experience developing predictive engineering methodologies that improve engineering decision quality.
Experience integrating enterprise AI capabilities into engineering methodologies supporting simulation, optimization, and engineering decision quality.
Knowledge of digital engineering, model-based engineering, digital twins, and advanced computational methods.
Strong understanding of model validation, verification, uncertainty quantification, and engineering best practices.
Demonstrated ability to translate computational analysis into practical engineering decisions.
Experience building reusable enterprise engineering capabilities rather than project-specific analytical support.
Strong executive communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to engineering, commercial, and executive leadership.
Demonstrated ability to influence engineering strategy across multiple organizations without direct reporting authority.

Travel Requirements

20%: Up to 52 business days per year

Physical Requirements

Light-Exerting up to 20lbs/9kg of force frequently, and/or negligible amount of force frequently constantly to move objects.

What We Offer

Community Involvement: West encourages volunteerism through its West without Borders initiative and other charitable programs that make a difference in local communities.
Continuous Learning & Development: Opportunities for professional growth through training programs, tuition assistance, leadership development, and skill-certification initiatives.
Inclusive & Collaborative Culture: A global workforce that values diversity, equity, and inclusion—where all voices are heard and respected in a supportive environment.
Global Career Opportunities: With facilities across North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific, employees have opportunities for international exposure and cross-functional collaboration.
Recognition & Rewards: Performance-based bonuses, service recognition, and employee appreciation initiatives celebrate dedication and impact.

West embraces diversity and equality of opportunity. We foster an environment where all individuals are safe, treated fairly, valued and respected. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or other applicable legally protected characteristics.
