jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager - Custody
jobs.description:
In 1968, the New York Stock Exchange began closing on Wednesdays so brokerage firms could catch up on paperwork. Every transaction depended on physical stock certificates being delivered, recorded, and reconciled. Trading had outgrown the infrastructure behind it. The expression “Paperwork crisis” had entered the nation's agenda resulting in other temporary measures like shortened trading days and extending settlement. The industry responded with electronic clearing systems and the establishment of the Depository Trust & Clearing Corporation (DTCC) laying the foundation for markets that could operate at an entirely different scale.

Every share needs an identity, every movement needs a record, and every balance needs to agree with the institutions holding the assets. The best financial infrastructure makes this complexity feel ordinary. Building it takes extraordinary care.

At Mercury, our Investments team helps founders put their capital to work through products like Treasury and Invest. Our Custody team builds the systems underneath that experience: the ledger, security master service, reconciliation, and operational tools that keep customer assets accurately accounted for and give our products a dependable foundation to grow.

We’re looking for a senior engineering manager to lead the Custody team through its next stages of growth and scale to better serve our small and large customers.

As part of this role, you will:

Lead, hire, and develop a team of senior engineers, providing thoughtful feedback and building a trusting and supportive environment.
Own the team’s technical strategy and roadmap, translating Mercury’s investment ambitions into focused priorities and predictable delivery.
Guide the design and evolution of core custody systems, including cash and securities ledgers, security master service, position tracking, and reconciliation.
Partner with product, investment operations, and compliance to turn business and regulatory requirements into well-designed systems, operational controls, and auditable workflows that balance correctness, scale, and maintainability.
Collaborate with Product and Partnerships to align integrations, responsibilities, and technical roadmaps.
Set a high bar for correctness, reliability, and incident response, balancing new capabilities with the maintenance and improvement of critical systems.

The ideal candidate for the role:

Has 3+ years of experience managing highly technical teams.
Has direct experience building or operating RIA and broker-dealer custody systems at scale, including ledgers, security master service, cash and securities reconciliation, and money movement.
Understands the broker-dealer operating model and how responsibilities and data flow across introducing brokers, clearing firms, and custodians.
Has worked closely with compliance and operations teams, translating requirements into practical engineering decisions and effective controls.
Understands the lifecycle of securities and the implications of settlement and corporate actions for customer cash and positions across equities, fixed income, ETFs, and mutual funds.

If this role interests you, we invite you to explore our public demo at demo.mercury.com/accounts/treasury.

jobs.description:
Description

Manager of Infrastructure, Security & Operations

Location: Wallick Corporate Office – New Albany, OH

Job Type: Full-time

Make a Difference—And Own Your Future

Join Wallick Communities, a 100% employee-owned company with over 55 years of experience in providing affordable housing and assisted living for families and seniors across the Midwest. With 1,000+ associates and a mission to open doors to homes, opportunity, and hope, we take pride in fostering a supportive and collaborative work environment where every employee-owner plays a vital role.

A Career with Wallick Means. . .

Creating Homes for People Who Need It Most: Providing new beginnings for residents seeking affordable, safe and high-quality housing where they can thrive.
Pay-on-Demand: access your money as you earn it.
Exceptional Benefit Package: Health, dental, vision insurance effective within 2 weeks of starting your new job, paid time off, gym membership reimbursement, paid parental leave, 401K, and more!
Work-Life Balance: Paid time off, including paid parental leave.
Learning & Support: A supportive team that cares about your continued development, well-being and professional growth.
Resident Stories That Stay with You: From Henry, who moved into his first-ever home, to Jaci, whose stay at a Wallick community allowed her to achieve homeownership and graduate college, kickstarting her dream career.
Work-Life Balance: Paid time off, including paid parental leave.
Career Growth: Tuition reimbursement, training, professional development, and advancement opportunities within a company that invests in its people.
Employee Owned, Resident Focused: As a 100% employee-owned company, your daily work (supporting our residents) also contributes to your financial future by sharing in our profitability.

What You’ll Do

The Manager of Infrastructure, Security & Operations leads the infrastructure, security, and operations functions. This is Pillar 3 of Wallick’s IT operating model (Power & Protect). This is a hands-on technical leader role which will do the work, coach the team, and set the direction. The Leader owns the IT Service Desk capability (partner-delivered) and personally carries critical security work while defining the long-term sourcing model for cybersecurity.
This role will set direction and lead the function to its future state: take complete ownership of the IT Service Desk capability and its continued maturation; define the cybersecurity operating model and sourcing strategy for the company’s future needs; develop a complete picture of the infrastructure estate, including the data center and the hybrid cloud environment, and chart its modernization path. This role is to be a visionary who executes: equal parts strategist, builder, operator, and mentor.

What We’re Looking For

Ten or more years of progressive IT infrastructure and security experience, including people leadership of technical teams and a demonstrated hands-on track record.
Deep working knowledge across at least three of these areas: identity and access management (Microsoft Entra), security operations and incident response, enterprise networking, cloud platforms (Azure preferred), IT service management.
Direct experience leading a service desk or managed service operation, including SLAs, scorecards, deflection, cost per ticket, user experience, and vendor performance management.
Experience shaping cybersecurity operating and sourcing strategy, and operating credibly with executives, auditors, insurers, and regulators on cyber and compliance topics.
Experience leading infrastructure modernization and support: data center strategy, cloud migration, hybrid environments, and business continuity and disaster recovery.
Must have a coaching and mentoring background to develop the team.
Composure and professional maturity under pressure.
Experience in regulated environments (HUD or LIHTC affordable housing, senior living, healthcare adjacent, or financial services) is a strong plus. ITIL familiarity is a plus.

Functions And Responsibilities

Leadership and Team Development:

Lead, coach, and mentor technical team members.
Serve as a working leader and technical escalation point.
Partner with IT leaders on shared priorities and architecture decisions.

IT Service Desk

Lead the IT Service Desk function and delivery partners.
Manage SLAs, scorecards, user experience, cost efficiency, and service improvements.
Drive adoption of automation, self-service, and AI-enabled support capabilities.

Cybersecurity And Trust

Own security posture, governance, compliance, awareness, incident preparedness, and risk management.
Lead identity and access management and data governance initiatives.

Infrastructure And Business Continuity

Oversee infrastructure strategy, modernization, Azure migration, networking, and end-user computing.
Maintain business continuity and disaster recovery capabilities.

Future View

Advance a partner and automation-enabled operating model.
Lead infrastructure and security architecture direction and roadmap investments.

Wallick’s Mission & Values

At Wallick Communities, We Believe In Opening Doors To Homes, Opportunity, And Hope For Our Residents, Associates, And Community. Our Core Values Guide Everything We Do

Care – We show compassion and respect for everyone.
Character – We do the right thing, even when no one is looking.
Collaboration – We work together to achieve more.

At Wallick, we celebrate Diversity, Equity, Inclusion + Belonging (DEI+B) in our workplace and communities, creating an environment where associates feel welcome, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to the great work they do every day.

For nearly 60 years, it has been at the core of our organization’s culture that all Wallick associates come to a safe and inclusive place to work. Wallick does not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), parental status, national origin, age, disability, genetic information (including family medical history), political affiliation, military service, or other non-merit-based factors.

Join Us and Become an Employee-Owner!

If you're ready to make a difference in people’s lives while securing your financial future, apply today!

Okta Solutions Engineering team members have the rare combination of technical savviness and business insight and will hone each of these skills through advising a diverse set of customers on what is possible using Okta’s Identity Platform. You own and report on the business impact of your team as they work with prospects who are evaluating the Okta identity platform.  Team activities include demonstrations, technical deep dives, trials and proof-of-value evaluations. 
You will actively work on deals, proposing strategies to help insure the success of opportunities.  This includes frequently participating in on-site deal support.
You will always promote the sense of “team within a team” by collaborating with the greater Pre Sales teams and business units at Okta.
Always recruiting!  You will attract, recruit, ramp, and mentor a team of great Solutions Engineers from diverse backgrounds and experiences.

Demonstrated success selling to US Public Sector (SLED preferred, or FED) Agencies. Ability to influence technical decision makers and executives, and service as an executive sponsor. Experience with and proponent of MEDDPICC and Value/Outcome based selling methodologies.
A vision for Okta’s opportunity in the market and how our customers will leverage Okta solutions to drive business outcomes.
12+ years Pre Sales experience with 4+ years of managerial/leadership experience
Bachelors of Science in engineering, science or mathematics or equivalent experience

And extra credit if you have experience in any of the following! 

Expertise in security product market trends and directional awareness of Okta’s roadmap and technology development efforts. Knowledge around the Okta platform and competitor product offerings.
Competency with security concepts and solutions; knowledge of customer enterprise security security software (firewalls, proxies, VPN, CASB, databases and applications) preferred.

AI data and process experience

Strong UKG product suite experience (e.g. Ultipro, Kronos, Dimensions, UKG Ready, Bryte)

Ability to create dynamic power point presentations

Creative, innovative, and cross-functional approach to problem solving while considering overarching organizational goals.

System design experience
Ability to partner with the business community and IT to achieve common objectives
Current knowledge of latest technology and practices available within the IT industry
HR & payroll process knowledge

Able to work in our office in Piscataway, NJ or New York, NY at least 3 days a week onsite required
Retail Industry is strongly preferred

jobs.title: Sr Director, Technology Strategy and Enablement
jobs.description:
Why Work Here?

“Mission driven, great benefits and room for growth!”

Why consider AORN, Association of periOperative Registered Nurses
, as the next place for your career as our Sr Director, Technology Strategy and Enablement
? Because we’re innovative and all about quality and collaboration – we’re continually seeking to enhance our offerings to allow us to better tailor to the needs of our nurse members while expanding our market position and growing revenue across our business and sales divisions.

Our mission is to define, support, and advocate for patient and staff safety through exemplary practice for each phase of perioperative nursing care using evidence-based guidelines, continuing education, and clinical practice resources. We collaborate with professional and regulatory organizations, industry leaders, and other health care partners who support our mission. Our culture is one of openness, teamwork, risk taking and being at the cutting edge of our field and we only look for employees who hold these same traits.

Values mean more to AORN than just bullets on a page. They drive our daily decisions and impact how we work as an organization:

Innovation:
Taking courageous and bold actions for growth and sustainability.
Communication:
Exemplifying respect, collaboration, transparency and honesty.
Quality:
Ensuring accountability and excellence.
Diversity, Equity, Inclusiveness:
Promoting fairness, valuing differences, considering all perspectives.
Achievement:
Achieving our mission, realizing the vision.

The Senior Director, Technology Strategy and Enablement
provides strategic and operational leadership for the organization's technology function, including technology strategy, software development, enterprise applications, IT operations, cybersecurity, enterprise architecture, and emerging technologies. This role ensures technology solutions, services, and investments effectively support organizational priorities, improve operational efficiency, and enable innovation.

Serving as the organization's senior technology leader, the Senior Director develops and executes the technology roadmap, partners with leaders across the organization to understand business needs, and translates those needs into scalable, secure, and effective technology solutions. jobs.title: Deputy Chief Technology Officer, Infrastructure
jobs.description:
SteerBridge is a modern technology company delivering innovative, mission‑focused solutions to the U.S. Government and private sector.
Leveraging deep expertise in federal acquisition, digital transformation, and emerging technologies, we deliver agile, commercial‑grade capabilities that accelerate operational effectiveness and drive measurable mission success.
At the core of SteerBridge is our people—especially the veterans whose leadership, problem‑solving mindset, and commitment to excellence elevate every project we support. We don’t simply hire exceptional talent; we cultivate it
, creating meaningful career pathways for veterans, military spouses, and professionals who share our passion for advancing technology and strengthening the missions we serve.

Position Overview

SteerBridge Strategies is seeking a Deputy Chief Technology Officer (DCTO), Infrastructure to own the cloud architecture, security compliance, corporate network, and IT foundation that underpin SteerBridge's federal technology portfolio. This role sits at the center of the company's technical operations, providing the secure, scalable, and compliant infrastructure that SteerBridge's mission programs, including VA disability claims modernization, aviation readiness analytics, and federal fintech platforms, are built on, as well as the internal IT and security posture of the company itself.
The Deputy CTO, Infrastructure reports to the CTO and works alongside the other Deputy CTOs and Architecture Review Boards to ensure every program inherits a consistent, defensible security and cloud foundation. This person will represent SteerBridge to government security authorizing officials and internal leadership alike, translating infrastructure and compliance decisions into business and mission risk terms.

Key Responsibilities

Cloud Architecture Leadership: Direct the design, governance, and continuous improvement of SteerBridge's cloud architecture across all program environments, ensuring consistent standards for scalability, resilience, and cost efficiency.
Security Compliance & Risk Management: Own the security compliance posture of SteerBridge's infrastructure, including RMF/ATO packages, continuous monitoring, and remediation of findings across all programs and corporate systems.
Corporate Network & IT Operations: Lead corporate network architecture and operations, including connectivity, segmentation, identity and access management, and endpoint protection for SteerBridge's internal IT environment.
Executive Stakeholder Engagement: Serve as a credible representative of SteerBridge's technical posture to government authorizing officials, auditors, and executive leadership, translating infrastructure and security decisions into mission and business risk terms.
Governance & Standards: Chair or participate in Architecture Review Boards and the Technical Risk Committee, ensuring infrastructure and security decisions across AICES, AIRES, SteerFi, and corporate IT remain aligned and auditable.
Program & People Leadership: Guide and mentor infrastructure, network, and security engineers; build career pathing and technical growth plans in partnership with SteerBridge's Career Ladder framework.
Vendor & Tooling Strategy: Evaluate and manage the vendor and tooling landscape for cloud, network, and security operations, ensuring cost-effective and compliant solutions across the company.
Cross-Program Coordination: Collaborate with program technical leads to identify, capture, and prioritize infrastructure and security requirements ahead of delivery milestones.
Delivery Management: Coordinate planning, sprint execution, and release management for infrastructure and security initiatives, and report progress, risks, and dependencies to executive leadership.

Required Qualifications

12+ years of experience in IT infrastructure, cloud architecture, or security engineering, including at least 5 years supporting federal or highly regulated environments.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field (required). Advanced degree preferred.
Proven ability to design and lead delivery of cloud-native infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP) supporting FedRAMP, RMF, and ATO requirements.
Deep understanding of enterprise network architecture, corporate IT operations, identity and access management, and endpoint security.
Strong command of NIST 800-53 controls, continuous monitoring, vulnerability management, and the federal Authority to Operate lifecycle.
Demonstrated leadership of cross-functional infrastructure, network, and security teams across multiple concurrent programs.
Exceptional communication, documentation, and executive stakeholder engagement skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Active certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, or Azure Solutions Architect Expert.
Experience with enterprise vulnerability scanning and compliance tooling (e.g., Tenable.SC/Nessus), SIEM platforms, and Zero Trust architecture.
Experience operating within VA Enterprise Cloud (VAEC), DoD IL4/IL5, or other federal accreditation boundaries.
Background managing security compliance across multiple concurrent ATO packages and program boundaries.
Familiarity with SOC operations, incident response planning, and corporate network segmentation strategy.

Dental insurance
Vision insurance
Life Insurance
401(k) Retirement Plan with matching
Paid Time Off
Paid Federal Holidays

Salary commensurate with background and experience will be offered.

jobs.title: Director of Information Technology
jobs.description:
Who We Are

IREX is a global solutions provider that partners with communities and institutions in the United States and around the world to cultivate leaders, expand access to education, and create economic opportunity. With deep expertise, a forward-looking vision, and world-class practices in AI for Education, Future-Ready Workforce, Higher Education Solutions, Leadership Development, and Online Safety, IREX delivers innovative and proven solutions that help people, institutions, and communities thrive in a rapidly changing world.

About The Role

The Director of Information Technology serves as IREX’s senior operational and technical leader for Information Technology and as the designated deputy to the Chief Technology Officer for delegated operational and technical matters. The Director provides technical leadership across cloud and infrastructure, cybersecurity operations, enterprise applications and integrations, AI and automation, service delivery, and technology partners. The Director serves as IREX’s senior technical escalation point and is expected to work directly within technology platforms when needed. As deputy to the CTO, the Director provides operational and technical continuity, independently resolves matters within delegated authority, and represents the technology function as delegated by the CTO.

We’re looking for our next team member – could it be you?

Range: $160,000 - $190,000

What You’ll Do

Technology Operations and Infrastructure

Lead day-to-day technology operations and maintain a stable, secure, scalable, and cost-effective technology environment.
Provide hands-on technical leadership for Microsoft 365, Azure, Entra ID, Intune, Microsoft Defender, networking, cloud infrastructure, endpoint management, and identity and access management.
Serve as the senior technical escalation point for complex issues and participate directly in troubleshooting and resolution.
Establish and maintain architecture, configuration, lifecycle, and operational standards in coordination with the CTO.
Ensure technology platforms are appropriately monitored, maintained, patched, backed up, documented, and supported.
Provide technical direction for IREX offices and programs operating across different countries and technology environments.
Maintain and test appropriate business continuity, disaster recovery, system resilience, and technology recovery capabilities.

Enterprise Applications and Integration

Lead the operational management and technical integration of IREX’s enterprise application portfolio, including ERP, HRIS, CRM, Microsoft 365, collaboration and knowledge platforms, and other business systems.
Work with business owners to translate requirements into practical technical solutions, system improvements, and integration opportunities.
Lead or participate directly in system implementation, configuration, integration, enhancement, migration, and troubleshooting.
Use APIs, scripting, Power Platform, and other integration technologies to improve interoperability and reduce manual processes.
Ensure enterprise applications have appropriate ownership, security, documentation, lifecycle management, integration, and support models.

AI, Automation and Agent Platforms

Partner with the CTO to translate AI and automation priorities into practical technical solutions.
Provide technical leadership for Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, and related AI and automation capabilities.

Cybersecurity Operations and Technology Risk

Implement, operate, and maintain technical security controls across identity and access management, endpoint security, vulnerability remediation, logging and monitoring, and configuration management.
Provide technical oversight of cybersecurity vendors and managed security services, including validating that delivered work meets IREX requirements.
Support incident response, audits, risk assessments, and remediation activities, including evidence collection and technical investigation.
Escalate significant cybersecurity incidents, unresolved technical risks, and proposed exceptions to security requirements to the CTO.

Strategy Implementation & Governance

Implement the IT strategy and governance framework established by the CTO, translating strategic direction into executable workplans, operational practices, and measurable milestones.
Lead execution of delegated strategic initiatives across infrastructure, cybersecurity, enterprise applications, automation, and service delivery to ensure progress against organizational priorities.
Track implementation progress, identify risks or barriers to delivery, and recommend adjustments to timelines, sequencing, or resourcing for CTO review and decision-making.
Establish practical governance routines, documentation, and decision-support processes that improve consistency, accountability, and operational follow-through across IT initiatives.
Ensure technology changes are adopted effectively by the organization through careful planning, stakeholder coordination, communications, training, and post-implementation support.
Provide the CTO with timely updates, analysis, and escalation of issues requiring strategic direction, policy decisions, or executive-level intervention.

Teamwork/Cross-Functional Leadership

Serve as a trusted technology advisor to departments and program teams, helping translate operational needs into practical, secure, and sustainable technology solutions.
Partner with functional leaders to understand business priorities, assess technology implications, and align IT support with organizational goals and user needs.
Influence and guide non-technical stakeholders by clearly explaining technology options, trade-offs, risks, and implementation impacts in accessible terms, building understanding and support for technology decisions and organizational change.
Facilitate cross-functional planning and coordination for technology initiatives that require shared ownership, process changes, user adoption, or operational readiness.
Build collaborative relationships across the organization to improve technology engagement, strengthen adoption of enterprise systems, and support consistent use of tools and platforms.
Represent IT in delegated cross-functional meetings and working groups, ensuring decisions are informed by technical feasibility, security considerations, user experience, and long-term sustainability.

Budget & Vendor Management

Manage technology vendor relationships within delegated areas of responsibility, including coordinating services, monitoring performance, resolving issues, and validating deliverables.
Review and approve vendor invoices within delegated authority, ensuring charges are accurate, aligned with contracted services, and supported by appropriate documentation.
Partner with the CTO and Procurement to support vendor sourcing, renewals, contract coordination, and evaluation of vendor performance and value.
Monitor budget spend for assigned technology services, licenses, tools, and vendor engagements, identifying variances, risks, or opportunities for cost control.
Provide input and analysis to support technology budget planning and forecasting, while recognizing that overall IT budget ownership and final budget accountability remain with the CTO.
Maintain practical oversight of software licensing, subscriptions, support agreements, and managed service arrangements to promote cost-effectiveness, compliance, and continuity of service.

Establish and monitor service levels and appropriate performance indicators.
Monitor responsiveness using defined service expectations, such as timely acknowledgment, prioritization, escalation, and resolution of support requests based on urgency, impact, and agreed service levels.
Ensure effective escalation and resolution of complex or high-impact issues.
Identify recurring issues and address underlying technical or process causes.
Promote a culture of accountability and continuous improvement by using service trends, user feedback, and recurring issues to improve processes, communication, and the overall technology experience.
Use ticket trends, service metrics, user feedback, and recurring issue analysis to identify continuous improvement priorities and implement practical changes that improve reliability, user satisfaction, response quality, and service consistency.
Maintain appropriate technical documentation, procedures, knowledge resources, and user guidance.

At IREX, our culture is built on our people—and on how we work together to create meaningful impact every day. We look for colleagues who bring purpose, curiosity, collaboration, and a bias for action to help strengthen communities and advance our mission.

Successful candidates build trust across differences, move ideas into action, seek new perspectives, adapt to change, and represent IREX with authenticity and professionalism. We value people who bring strong expertise and a generous team spirit to work that advances our mission.

What You’ll Bring

Responsibilities Of The VP, Data Platform & Product Management

Define and own the multi-year product strategy and roadmap for an enterprise data platform.
Lead strategy across data ingestion, storage, processing, governance, and consumption.
Build and scale platform capabilities supporting AI/ML and analytics initiatives.
Lead and develop Product Management teams across the data domain.
Partner closely with Engineering and Architecture on platform scalability, reliability, security, and performance.
Drive product discovery, requirements, prioritization, and execution.
Define metrics around platform adoption, data quality, latency, and customer outcomes.
Partner directly with C-level executives and senior leaders across Product, Engineering, GTM, and other functions.
Evaluate emerging data technologies and architecture patterns, including real-time streaming, lakehouse, and distributed data platforms.
Engage with customers and external stakeholders to help inform product and platform strategy.

Required Experience/Skills for the VP, Data Platform & Product Management:

10+ years of Product Management experience with significant leadership experience at the VP, Head of Product, or Senior Director level.
Experience within a large, established enterprise software or B2B SaaS organization.
Proven experience owning and building an enterprise data platform end-to-end, beginning with ingestion.
Deep technical understanding across modern data architecture, infrastructure, streaming, cloud data warehouses, lakehouse architectures, APIs, and governance.
Experience leading Product Management teams across complex platform initiatives.
Strong experience partnering with and influencing C-level executives.
Ability to translate highly technical concepts into product and business strategy.
Strong executive communication and stakeholder-management skills.
Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, highly autonomous global environment.

Preferred Experience/Skills for the VP, Data Platform & Product Management:

Experience building data platforms that support AI/ML products.
Experience with AWS, Azure, and/or GCP.
Exposure to technologies such as Snowflake, Databricks, Kafka, and dbt.
Experience with enterprise data governance, privacy, and compliance.
Experience building externally facing data products or developer platforms.
Experience within complex, high-volume enterprise software environments.

Education Requirements

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience is required.
An advanced degree is preferred.

Benefits

Comprehensive executive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage.
Retirement benefits.
Paid time off.
Annual incentive compensation and significant long-term equity participation.

At MGIC, we take pride in knowing that what we do matters. As pioneers of private mortgage insurance, we help people achieve homeownership sooner - making affordable low-down-payment mortgages a reality. Our efforts have helped more than 14 million people get the keys to their own homes sooner than otherwise possible. Every position is critical to our company's success - from the analytical to the technical; from the innovative to the operational. The customer-facing roles to behind-the-scenes experts, we're all part of one team. We're an organization with a national footprint that's large enough to never lack for a new challenge, but small enough for an opportunity to make an impact and influence decisions. Come make a difference at MGIC.

PURPOSE

Serves as a liaison between MGIC and technology partners by managing integration initiatives that support the business and customer experience strategies. Leads cross-functional efforts to deliver integration solutions and enhance MGIC’s position within the mortgage technology ecosystem.

Primary Duties And Responsibilities

Engages with mortgage technology providers to advance integration objectives and business priorities.
Facilitates partner onboarding and integration initiatives by serving as the primary point of contact for coordination, issue resolution, project planning, communication, and successful delivery.
Partner with Marketing to contribute to the go-to-market plan for new B2B API integrated solutions and significant MI-related enhancements to existing B2B partner platforms.
Conducts research and analysis to support roadmap prioritization, integration, enhancements, customer experience improvements, and new partnership opportunities.
Coordinates with technology providers to prioritize and adopt integration strategies that align with business objectives and improve customer outcomes.
Identifies and resolves operational, technical, and relationship-related issues through collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.
Attends industry conferences, customer meetings, and partner’s events to strengthen relationships, identify opportunities, and enhance visibility to technology capabilities.
Travel up to 20% of the time.
Performs other duties as assigned.

Experience / Background

5+ Years of experience related to the essential duties as described above.
In-depth understanding of mortgage origination, servicing, secondary market operations, and the mortgage technology ecosystem.
Knowledge of integration concepts, digital product delivery, and partner enablement strategies.
Understanding of B2B API integration product deliverables and management concepts.
Understanding of MISMO standards development and maintenance.
Ability to independently manage complex relationships and influence decision-making among internal and external partners.
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to evaluate multiple solutions and make sound business recommendations.
Ability to translate and communicate complex technical concepts into business-focused recommendations across multiple audiences.
Proven project leadership skills with accountability for delivering results across cross-functional teams.
Strong negotiation, presentation, and consensus-building skills.
Ability to identify strategic opportunities and align recommendations with business objectives and customer strategies.

Pay Range:

$87,990.00 - $149,590.00

This range aligns with current market data and reflects our commitment to competitive and equitable compensation. Salary offers are based on factors such as experience, skills, education, and training. The range may vary in certain locations to reflect local market conditions. It is not typical to initiate pay at the top of the range to account for internal equity and allow for future and continued salary growth

Enjoy these benefits from day one:

Competitive Salary & pay-for-performance bonus
Financial Benefits (401k with company match, profit sharing, HSA, wellness program)
On-site Fitness Center and classes (corporate office)
Paid-time off and paid company holidays
Business casual dress

Explore your next opportunity at a Fortune Global 500 organization. Envision innovative possibilities, experience our rewarding culture, and work with talented teams that help you become better every day. We know what it takes to lead UPS into tomorrow—people with a unique combination of skill + passion. If you have the qualities and drive to lead yourself or teams, there are roles ready to cultivate your skills and take you to the next level.

Job Description

RoadieXD is scaling a fast-growing same-day delivery network for large, heavy, and bulky goods.

As Vice President, RoadieXD Operations & Engineering, you will lead the evolution of a nationwide cross-dock and sortation network with 50+ locations and continued significant growth ahead. You will combine operational leadership, engineering expertise, and supply chain experience to build a scalable operating model that improves service, efficiency, quality, and capacity.

This is a build-and-scale role. You will help transform an emerging operation into a repeatable, high-performing national network while preserving the speed and entrepreneurial culture that make Roadie unique.

What You’ll Do

Lead operational strategy and execution across RoadieXD’s nationwide cross-dock and sortation network.
Design and scale operating models that support rapid growth in volume, customers, and network complexity.
Reengineer processes including induction, sortation, route build, dispatch readiness, and related workflows.
Establish KPIs, operating standards, and management routines that drive service, productivity, quality, and efficiency.
Identify operational constraints and implement scalable engineering and process solutions.
Partner with third-party logistics providers and cross-functional UPS and Roadie teams to ensure consistent execution.
Support the launch and optimization of new sites and capabilities across the network.
Lead through influence, collaboration, and servant leadership in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial environment.

What You’ll Bring

Significant leadership experience in logistics, transportation, supply chain, fulfillment, distribution, or a related environment.
Demonstrated experience in final-mile or last-mile delivery.
Strong expertise in supply chain management, process engineering, industrial engineering, or a related discipline.
Proven success designing, launching, transforming, or scaling complex operations or multi-site networks.
Experience building operational KPIs, standards, and performance-management systems.
Experience working with third-party logistics providers or outsourced operations.
Fulfillment, cross-dock, sortation, distribution center, or e-commerce operations experience strongly preferred.
Strong executive communication, influencing, and change-leadership skills.
Ability to adapt across entrepreneurial, corporate, and third-party operating environments.
Flexible U.S. location; Atlanta preferred but not required.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
The New York Post is one of America’s most iconic and recognizable news brands — delivering bold headlines, unforgettable scoops, and sharp commentary since 1801. With a legacy built on fearless journalism and a distinctly New York attitude, The Post has evolved far beyond its print roots to become a modern media powerhouse.

Today, the New York Post Digital Network is one of the most influential voices in the industry, reaching over 80 million unique users each month across our expansive, ever-growing portfolio. Anchored by NYPost.com, PageSix.com, and Decider.com, our digital brands deliver must-read breaking news, sports, entertainment, pop culture, and lifestyle coverage with the same wit, edge, and energy that define The Post. With innovation at our core, we’ve built a true multi-platform ecosystem — spanning web, mobile apps, video, audio, social, print, TV, and commerce. From viral headlines and exclusive stories to original series, podcasts, and live events, we’re engaging audiences where they are — and always on the pulse of what’s next.

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineering Manager
to join our technology team and lead the systems that power The Post’s digital future. This is a hands-on engineering role with core responsibilities around infrastructure services, data pipelines, personalization systems, consumer AI, internal AI tooling, and custom APIs across AWS and GCP projects.

You are a hands-on technical leader who builds robust high-performance services for websites. You will own the plumbing that enables our newsroom, data science, marketing, and product teams to deliver cutting-edge digital experiences at scale. You’ll work alongside technology leadership in a fast-paced newsroom. You will partner with editorial leaders, share architectural solutions with other business units in the US, UK, and Australia, and direct your engineering team with experienced tactics and thoughtful strategy.

Please Note: Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis. Sponsorship, including employment visa sponsorship or transfer, is not available for this position now or in the future.

Key Responsibilities:

Manage and support a small team of high-achieving agile software and data engineers.
Design, build, and operate cloud-based APIs supporting specialized needs of our consumer websites, native mobile apps.
Work daily with compute services, query services, storage services, and big data services with technologies like Vertex AI, Lambdas, DynamoDB, Cloud Functions, S3, Kubernetes, Glue, and BigQuery.
Be able to personally troubleshoot an issue from Javascript in a browser down through DNS, networking, applications, containers and operating systems or serverless services, and into dependent service tiers.
Own data ingestion pipelines for real-time and batch processing of large-scale content and event data.
Understand how to implement and scale custom APIs to support editorial workflows, AI, personalization, analytics, and user-facing applications.
Own the team’s codebases, pull requests, testing, maintenance and release process.
Partner with product, editorial, and data science teams to deliver infrastructure and services that meet business needs.
Monitor, optimize, and improve the reliability, security, and cost efficiency of cloud-based systems.
Communicate and present a vision for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Organize architecture discussions.
Run and/or supervise agile sprint ceremonies.

Qualifications:

Must-Haves

MS or BS in computer science, or related field.
10+ years of professional software engineering experience.
5+ years experience leading engineering teams.
Agile best practices.
Proficiency in modern programming languages and frameworks such as Python, Node.js, or Go.
Solid familiarity of common AWS and/or GCP services .
Robust experience with REST and GraphQL APIs, authentication/authorization, and API best practices.
Firm grasp of the tools of the trade including AI tools, IDEs, Git, JIRA, and agile methodologies.
Comfort with code reviews, unit tests, QA and UAT processes, and knowledge of end-to-end testing frameworks.
Strong troubleshooting skills
Attention to detail, thoroughness, a proactive approach to problem-solving, and a comfort in diving in and learning things from scratch.
Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Great-to-Have Experience

Familiarity with content-management systems, media, news, publishing, video technology, ad technology, or other high-traffic consumer-facing industries.
Hands-on experience with generative-AI models, LLM prompting, and/or machine learning.
Personalization and recommendation systems.
Experience building and deploying data pipelines (e.g., Airflow, Dataflow, Glue, or similar tools)
Comfort with Linux administration, shell scripting, ssh, crontabs, etc.
Experience with monitoring, logging, dashboard, and alarming tools (e.g., CloudWatch, Datadog, Splunk, etc.)
Knowledge of data warehouse technologies (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, etc.)
Understanding of CI/CD workflows and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes a plus)

Note: The New York Post follows a hybrid work model. This position would be expected to be in the office a minimum of 3 days per week (subject to change).

Equal Opportunity Employer

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other protected characteristic. EEO/Disabled/Vets

Head of Engineering | AI / Fintech | New York

$250k-$300k base + meaningful equity

Some Head of Engineering roles are really management jobs - this one isn't.

I'm working with a well-backed Seed-stage AI/fintech company in New York that is building infrastructure to make business verification faster, more reliable and easier to scale globally.

They're looking for a Head of Engineering who has already made the transition from strong engineer to engineering leader, without leaving the engineering behind.

You'll spend roughly half your time building and half leading.

That means writing production code, making architecture decisions and getting deep into technical problems, while also hiring the team, setting the engineering bar and working directly with the founders on product and company direction.

You'll take responsibility for engineering as the business moves through its next stage of growth.

You'll:

Remain hands-on in the codebase and ship alongside the team
Build and scale the engineering organisation
Own the technical vision and architecture as the platform grows
Lead the company's AI engineering strategy and production AI systems
Work directly with the founders on product direction, UX and technical priorities
Set the hiring bar and recruit the next generation of engineers
Build systems capable of supporting demanding enterprise customers across multiple markets

This isn't a role for someone looking to manage engineering from a distance.

The background we're looking for:

The strongest people for this role will have spent meaningful time in early-stage startups, ideally Seed through Series B
, and know what it feels like when the product, team and architecture are all evolving at once.

You'll likely have:

7-15 years in software engineering
Built and led an engineering team, rather than simply inheriting one
Written production code recently and still enjoy being close to the technical work
Owned architecture and technical direction as a product scaled
Shipped AI/ML systems into production
Strong product instincts and the ability to influence what gets built, not just how
Experience building B2B or enterprise software
A Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics or similarly technical background

Experience in fintech, identity, KYC/KYB, fraud, risk or another regulated environment
would be highly relevant, but isn't essential.

The Opportunity:

This is an early leadership hire in a company with strong backing, real customer traction and ambitious plans to expand internationally.

The engineering problems sit across AI, data, workflow automation, enterprise infrastructure and complex business verification.

You'll have genuine influence over the product, architecture, engineering culture and team that gets built from here.

The remit is broad by design.

You'll be expected to think like an engineer, product builder and company leader rather than operating inside a narrow engineering-management box.

Package:

Base:
$250k-$300k
Equity:
Meaningful ownership
Location:
New York City
Working pattern:
Strong preference for being in the office

Transfers can be considered

Who should apply?

If you've previously been a Founding Engineer, Engineering Lead, Head of Engineering, Director of Engineering or hands-on CTO
, this could be particularly relevant.

Especially if your career has looked something like:
build the product → hire the team → lead the team → keep building

If you're still happiest when you can review the architecture, write code, talk to a customer and interview an engineer in the same week, I'd like to hear from you.

The Sr. Director, Technical Program Management will lead a global technical program management organization responsible for driving execution of strategic AI/Datacenter Infrastructure Power package engineering and new product introduction (NPI) programs. The organization will also provide technical program management leadership at key OSATs, ensuring consistent execution, issue escalation, and alignment between Renesas development teams and external assembly partners.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Lead the global Technical Program Management (TPM) organization supporting AI/Datacenter Infrastructure Power NPI and package engineering programs.

Partner with Package Engineering Directors who lead technical package development programs, providing program-level execution leadership, governance, and accountability.

Establish and drive end-to-end NPI program plans, milestones, critical paths, resource alignment, risk management, and executive reporting to ensure committed schedules are achieved.

Create a disciplined program management operating model covering development, qualification, customer requirements, production readiness, ramp, and transition to volume manufacturing.

Proactively identify technical, quality, reliability, supply, manufacturing, and schedule risks; establish mitigation plans and escalate critical issues with clear recommendations and decision points.

Lead cross-functional technical task forces for major development challenges, particularly issues affecting quality, reliability, yield, manufacturability, qualification, or NPI schedule.

Drive structured problem solving and closure of critical issues using data-driven methods, root-cause analysis, risk assessment, and clearly defined corrective/preventive actions.

Coordinate closely with Package Engineering, Power product group partners—especially Design, Application, and Marketing teams—Product Engineering, Reliability, Quality, Operations, Supply Chain, and other functional leaders to remove execution barriers and maintain program momentum.

Establish program dashboards and management systems that provide transparent visibility to milestones, critical path activities, risks, issues, action owners, and recovery plans.

Lead technical program management activities with key OSAT/CM partners, including program reviews, milestone tracking, issue escalation, recovery plans, qualification readiness, and production ramp execution.

Ensure execution of Engineering Build Requests (EBRs) per committed schedule at each OSAT, regularly tracking overall EBR progress, identifying delays, and driving timely recovery actions.

Develop and lead TPM teams located at strategic OSATs, ensuring alignment with Renesas priorities, technical teams, and global NPI schedules.

Ensure OSAT/CM development activities, DOE, process optimization, qualification, process-window verification, production controls, and ramp readiness are aligned with overall NPI program objectives.

Drive timely resolution of process integration and assembly issues that could impact product quality, reliability, qualification, yield, or customer commitments.

Ensure effective transition from development and qualification into production, including readiness reviews, ramp monitoring, issue management, and sustained execution.

Establish standardized program management processes, templates, metrics, escalation mechanisms, and lessons-learned practices across the global organization.

Provide concise, fact-based executive communication on program health, critical risks, schedule recovery, resource needs, and decisions required from senior leadership.

Build strong relationships with OSAT/CM executive and technical leadership to improve responsiveness, accountability, and execution of critical AI/Datacenter Power programs.

Develop the technical and leadership capabilities of the TPM organization and establish a high-performance, execution-focused culture.

Support package technology roadmap execution by translating strategic technology priorities into executable development programs, milestones, resources, and deliverables.

Address internal and external customer-impacting issues in partnership with Marketing, Product, Quality, Operations, and Package Engineering organizations.

LEADERSHIP & ORGANIZATIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES

Lead and develop a global team of Technical Program Managers supporting strategic AI/Datacenter Infrastructure Power programs.

Set organizational priorities, staffing strategy, performance expectations, and development plans aligned with business growth.

Establish clear accountability between Technical Program Managers and Package Engineering technical leaders while avoiding duplication of technical ownership.

Create a culture of urgency, fact-based decision making, cross-functional collaboration, ownership, and rapid issue resolution.

Drive consistent execution standards across internal teams and strategic OSAT locations.

Qualifications

QUALIFICATIONS

Doctorate, Master’s, or Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, Chemistry, or a related technical discipline.

15–20+ years of relevant experience in semiconductor engineering, product development, applications, package development, NPI, manufacturing, technical program management, or a closely related field.

Demonstrated experience leading complex semiconductor NPI programs involving package development, assembly, qualification, reliability, and manufacturing ramp.

Strong understanding of semiconductor product development process, package and assembly processes.

Experience in Power Management products, particularly power SiP/modules, Smart Power Stages, Vertical Power Stages, Power Modules, Discrete FET packages, battery management system, PMICs, wafer-level and/or flip-chip technologies.

Experience working with OSATs/CMs and managing complex development and production activities across geographically distributed organizations.

Proven track record leading cross-functional technical task forces and resolving complex issues involving quality, reliability, yield, manufacturability, and schedule.

Strong understanding of qualification, reliability, SPC/statistical methods, process development, risk management, and structured problem-solving methodologies.

Exceptional program management skills, including critical-path management, risk management, executive escalation, schedule recovery, and cross-functional resource alignment.

Strong interpersonal, communication, negotiation, and executive presentation skills.

Ability to influence senior technical and business leaders without direct authority and drive accountability across organizational boundaries.

Experience building and leading global teams, including teams in product groups, embedded at external manufacturing or OSAT locations.

Strong analytical skills and ability to translate complex technical issues into clear business impact, decisions, and actions.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Experience supporting high-growth customer programs.

Experience with Smart Power Stage, Vertical Power Stage, power module, discrete FET, SiC/GaN, DBC/AMB, multi-chip, wafer-level, or advanced interconnect technologies.

Experience with formal technical program management methodologies and portfolio-level governance.

Experience driving customer-critical NPI programs in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

SUCCESS MEASURES

On-time achievement of NPI milestones and customer commitments.

Reduction in schedule delays caused by unresolved technical, quality, reliability, or manufacturing issues.

Timely closure of critical cross-functional task-force actions.

Improved qualification, yield, reliability, and production-readiness performance.

Effective execution and alignment of strategic OSAT/CM partners.

Development of a high-performing global TPM organization and standardized program-management operating model.

In 1968, the New York Stock Exchange began closing on Wednesdays so brokerage firms could catch up on paperwork. Every transaction depended on physical stock certificates being delivered, recorded, and reconciled. Trading had outgrown the infrastructure behind it. The expression “Paperwork crisis” had entered the nation's agenda resulting in other temporary measures like shortened trading days and extending settlement. The industry responded with electronic clearing systems and the establishment of the Depository Trust & Clearing Corporation (DTCC) laying the foundation for markets that could operate at an entirely different scale.

Every share needs an identity, every movement needs a record, and every balance needs to agree with the institutions holding the assets. The best financial infrastructure makes this complexity feel ordinary. Building it takes extraordinary care.

At Mercury, our Investments team helps founders put their capital to work through products like Treasury and Invest. Our Custody team builds the systems underneath that experience: the ledger, security master service, reconciliation, and operational tools that keep customer assets accurately accounted for and give our products a dependable foundation to grow.

We’re looking for a senior engineering manager to lead the Custody team through its next stages of growth and scale to better serve our small and large customers.

As part of this role, you will:

Lead, hire, and develop a team of senior engineers, providing thoughtful feedback and building a trusting and supportive environment.
Own the team’s technical strategy and roadmap, translating Mercury’s investment ambitions into focused priorities and predictable delivery.
Guide the design and evolution of core custody systems, including cash and securities ledgers, security master service, position tracking, and reconciliation.
Partner with product, investment operations, and compliance to turn business and regulatory requirements into well-designed systems, operational controls, and auditable workflows that balance correctness, scale, and maintainability.
Collaborate with Product and Partnerships to align integrations, responsibilities, and technical roadmaps.
Set a high bar for correctness, reliability, and incident response, balancing new capabilities with the maintenance and improvement of critical systems.

The ideal candidate for the role:

Has 3+ years of experience managing highly technical teams.
Has direct experience building or operating RIA and broker-dealer custody systems at scale, including ledgers, security master service, cash and securities reconciliation, and money movement.
Understands the broker-dealer operating model and how responsibilities and data flow across introducing brokers, clearing firms, and custodians.
Has worked closely with compliance and operations teams, translating requirements into practical engineering decisions and effective controls.
Understands the lifecycle of securities and the implications of settlement and corporate actions for customer cash and positions across equities, fixed income, ETFs, and mutual funds.

new_jobs.title: Founding Head of Product & Engineering
new_jobs.description:
SYNDRI | New York City preferred | Full-time

About SYNDRI

SYNDRI is the world’s first consumer-facing AI jewelry designer. Customers can design custom fine jewelry through conversation, starting with an idea, image, reference or existing piece. They can explore and refine the design visually, send it to pricing, approve the final design and CAD and 3D imaging and have the piece produced by skilled jewelers.

SYNDRI is currently in private beta. The core product is built and we are now focused on refining the experience, expanding the product roadmap and preparing to scale.

We’re looking for our first senior product hire to own that next phase.

The Role

As Founding Head of Product & Engineering, you will work directly with the founder and take ownership of both the product experience and the technical evolution of SYNDRI.

There is a significant roadmap ahead. Your job is to make the product dramatically better: refine the existing experience, decide what should be built next, improve the underlying AI systems and execute quickly.

This is not a traditional Head of Product role where you primarily manage a roadmap and hand requirements to engineers. You should be technical enough to work directly in the product yourself — understanding the codebase, prototyping and implementing improvements, evaluating models and APIs, debugging issues and making informed technical decisions.

You will have engineering support, but you will be the internal technical owner of the product. You should be comfortable getting hands-on yourself whenever that is the fastest or best way to solve a problem.

At the same time, this is not a pure engineering role. You will think deeply about the customer, product experience, roadmap and business - and make decisions about what is worth building in the first place.

SYNDRI sits at the intersection of AI, consumer product, design, ecommerce and physical production. The software needs to feel creative and intuitive while ultimately producing a real object that can be priced, manufactured and delivered. A major part of the opportunity is figuring out how more of that journey can become intelligent, automated and scalable over time.

What You'll Own

Product strategy, roadmap and prioritization
The technical direction and evolution of the SYNDRI product
The end-to-end customer experience, from first idea through finished commission
Refining and expanding the existing core product
Improving the quality, reliability and intelligence of the AI design experience
Evaluating and integrating new models, APIs and AI capabilities
Prototyping and implementing product improvements directly when appropriate
Developing intelligent workflows across conversation, imagery, structured product information, pricing and production
Improving how information moves between generated designs and downstream systems
Identifying opportunities to automate currently manual parts of the design-to-production process
Product QA, user testing, experimentation and analytics
Debugging product issues and solving edge cases quickly
Making pragmatic technical decisions about what to build internally, what to automate and what to use third-party tools for
Working with engineering support on larger or more specialized builds
Eventually helping build the product and engineering organization as SYNDRI grows

Who We're Looking For

You are an ambitious, highly technical builder who wants to move fast, solve hard problems and take real ownership in building something meaningful at scale.

You have:
Significant experience building and shipping technology products, ideally with meaningful 0→1 or early-stage ownership
Strong product judgment and an exceptional instinct for consumer experience
Strong technical fluency and the ability to work directly with an existing product and codebase
Hands-on experience building with modern AI models, APIs and generative AI systems
Experience working with LLMs, image models, multimodal systems, structured outputs or related AI technologies
The ability to prototype and implement product ideas yourself rather than relying on engineers for every iteration
Enough engineering depth to debug problems, evaluate technical approaches and make sound architecture decisions
An understanding of APIs, databases, data structures and modern web applications
Comfort working across text, images and structured data
The ability to think through how complex human workflows can progressively become software-driven or automated
Experience working closely with engineers and knowing when something should be built yourself versus handed to a specialist
The ability to move quickly through ambiguity and turn ideas into working product
A willingness to be extremely hands-on - testing outputs, building prototypes, reviewing flows, talking to customers and digging into edge cases yourself
Excellent written and verbal communication

Experience in consumer AI, multimodal AI, creative tools, e-commerce, marketplaces, computational design or software connecting digital experiences to physical products is particularly relevant.
Jewelry experience is not required, but a genuine understanding of or interest in fine jewelry would be a major plus.

You'll Probably Love This Role If:

You want to be close to both the customer and the technology.
You like figuring out problems that do not already have an obvious solution.
You want to spend more time building, testing and solving than managing process.
You enjoy moving between a product decision, an AI experiment, a technical problem and a customer experience without treating them as separate jobs.
You want significant ownership and want to join early enough that your decisions shape both the product and the technical foundation of the company.

Location

New York City preferred.
We are open to exceptional candidates elsewhere in the U.S., but this role will work extremely closely with the founder and will be a core member of the founding team.

Compensation

$200,000–$250,000 base salary + meaningful early-stage equity, depending on experience and technical depth.

To Apply

If this sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend the next few years solving, we’d love to hear from you.

Please send your LinkedIn or resume along with a few sentences about something you personally built.

We’d especially like to understand a product or technical problem where you had to figure out both what the right solution was and how to make it work.

If relevant, include links to products, prototypes, GitHub projects or other work that helps us understand how you build.

We care much less about polished cover letters than about understanding what you personally owned, built and shipped.

new_jobs.title: Senior Transportation Engineering Manager
new_jobs.description:
Hanson Values

Integrity | Commitment | Quality | Relationships | Innovation

If you’re looking for a firm that encourages innovative thinking and challenges you every day, with an opportunity to learn and advance, a career at Hanson is right for you. The belief in sustainability within our company’s practices creates a focus on client success and partnerships that are important to our communities and our environment.

A Day in the Life of a Senior Transportation Engineering Manager at Hanson

By joining our Chicago Loop, Lisle, or Peoria office in this role, you will:

Step into a leading role on major Hanson projects in Illinois, such as the Tollway I-355/I-88 Interchange master planning project near Chicago and the IDOT I-80 Mississippi River Bridge replacement and interchange reconstruction project between Illinois and Iowa.
Provide day-to-day leadership, workload coordination, and technical direction for an assigned group of engineers and technical staff.
Serve as project engineer on complex transportation assignments, coordinating disciplines and subconsultants, managing design activities, supporting schedules, and reviewing team deliverables.
Coach and mentor staff through regular feedback, career discussions, technical guidance, stretch assignments, and performance reviews.
Forecast short- and long-term staffing needs by evaluating backlog, anticipated pursuits, resource availability, capability gaps, and hiring requirements.
Develop roadway design solutions for complex interstate, tollway, urban arterial, highway, and local road improvement projects.
Direct the development of construction plans and contract documents. Author technical documents such as engineering reports and special provisions.
Guide roadway design teams using OpenRoads Designer, supported by internal training resources and active user groups.
Review complex technical calculations, reports, plans, and deliverables.
Lead or support client relationships, pursuits, scopes, fees, and proposals.
Provide occasional support for public involvement activities.
Travel occasionally for client meetings and site visits.
Perform other related duties as assigned.

What We’re Looking For

The following qualifications will help you succeed in this role:

Skills

Illinois DOT/Tollway planning, design, plan production, and PS&E experience.
Working knowledge of roadway design software such as OpenRoads Designer.
Familiarity with OpenRoads Designer 3D modeling for roadway projects is a plus.
Interest in continued learning, professional growth, and expanding technical and leadership skills.
Experience supervising, mentoring, or formally leading engineers and technical staff.
Strong technical judgment, problem-solving ability, organization, and attention to detail.
Experience leading or supporting quality control reviews to ensure adherence with industry and client design standards.
Excellent communication and teamwork skills.

Education/Experience

Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering is required.
Typically 10+ years of professional engineering experience.
Minimum of six years of roadway design or transportation engineering experience, including work for IDOT and/or the Illinois Tollway.
Illinois Professional Engineer license, or the ability to obtain an Illinois license through reciprocity within six months of hire.

Salary range: $150,000 – $190,000 per year. Compensation will be based on experience, technical qualifications, and overall fit for the role. This position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus.

Benefits

Our focus on people means we offer a generous benefits program to help you create a solid foundation for health and security throughout your career, including:

Competitive compensation
Performance bonuses
401(k) with matching contribution
Employee Stock Ownership Plan
Comprehensive health & well-being plans
Financial wellness plans
Work-life balance programs

Want to know more? Visit our benefits page for all the details.

Culture

About

We understand that selecting a job is about more than the day-to-day tasks. It’s important to feel like you belong and safe to grow and progress along your career path. You’ll find that at Hanson. We have an inclusive, diverse workforce awaiting to connect with you and numerous opportunities to cultivate your career, including:

Monthly educational webinars
Leadership training
Lunch & learn development sessions
24/7 access to thousands of skill-building courses
Mentorship opportunities
Award-winning internship program
Employee recognition
And so much more!

new_jobs.title: Director of Engineering and Documentation
new_jobs.description:
Description

TITLE:
Director of Engineering and Documentation

Reports To:
President

Supervise:
Documentation Supervisor and Engineers

Job Summary

This role provides strategic leadership and oversight for the sustainability engineering functions and documentation and configuration management. Guiding and directing a documentation and a team of engineers. This role is accountable for the sustainability engineering and full documentation disciplines — from tactical execution quality to long-term strategic direction. This role also partners closely with senior leadership, program management, and key stakeholders to align sustainability of product adoptions within business growth objectives, drives enterprise-wide process transformation initiatives, and ensures the organization meets its highest standards for compliance, data integrity, and operational excellence. Supports the interaction between engineering, manufacturing operations, and program management. This role requires the vision to see the future state, the credibility to influence it, and the execution discipline to deliver it.

COMPLEXITY & PROBLEM SOLVING

Works on issues where analysis of situations or data requires conceptual thinking and an in-depth knowledge of organizational objectives. Problems are not clearly defined and lack strategic direction. Implements policies and select methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria for obtaining results. Drives the strategy and success of larger projects which contribute to multiple areas of the organization.

This role may also work on complex issues where problems are not clearly defined and where fundamental principles do not fully apply. Translates business segment strategy into functional plans and guides execution. Participates in corporate development of methods, techniques and evaluation criteria for projects, programs, and people. Ensures budgets (partial) and schedules meet corporate requirements.

SCOPE OF MANGEMENT & SUPERVISION

Manages activities of two or more disciplines within a department. Oversee experienced level professionals and/or may be responsible for subordinate supervisors. Frequently advises team(s) on moderately complex matters. Accountable for department budget which may be broad and have far reaching impact on the business segment. Directs the activities of a functional areas through team and team supervisor. Leads team(s) to develop new methods and solve complex matters.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Organizational Development

Define and execute the multi-year documentation and configuration management strategy, aligning functional capabilities with the organization's growth, quality, and compliance objectives.
Build a culture of excellence, ownership, and continuous improvement that attracts and retains top documentation talent.
Lead, mentor, and develop a team of engineers and technical staff, providing regular feedback, career guidance, and professional development opportunities
Serve as a key contributor to department strategy development, translating organizational goals into actionable team objectives and initiatives
Ability to think and draw conclusions quickly, adapt to change, be open to new ideas, take on new responsibilities, handle pressure, and adjust plans and priorities to meet changing needs
Plans for and uses resources efficiently, looks for ways to reduce costs, creates accurate and realistic budgets, tracks and adjusts budgets, contributes to budget planning
Effectively communicate project expectations to project team members and stakeholders in a timely and clear fashion.
Facilitate the definition of project goals, tasks, and resource requirements; resolve or assist in the resolution of conflicts within and between projects or functional areas; develop methods to monitor project progress

Enterprise Documentation & Configuration Management

The document control focus specializes in implementing and maintaining an engineering change notice system. These changes will include product improvements, obsolescence management and product development.
Own enterprise documentation standards, policies, and governance frameworks applicable across all programs, sites, and customers.
Drive cross-site configuration management maturity — establishing consistent CMP frameworks, CCB governance models, and CM audit cadences.
Serve as the organization's senior escalation point for the most complex documentation, change control, and configuration disputes requiring executive engagement.
Lead the documentation function through major organizational events — ERP migrations, PLM platform transitions, new site launches, or large program onboards.
Ensures all contractual requirements pertaining to configuration management are implemented and followed on a given program.

Customer, Program & Executive Engagement

Represent the documentation function at the executive and customer level, participating in program reviews, contract negotiations, and strategic planning sessions.
Build and maintain trusted relationships with key customers, serving as the senior point of contact for documentation-related performance, corrective action, and capability discussions.
Translate customer and market requirements into functional capability investments and process improvements.
Collaborate with product/program managers and cross-functional teams to identify customer needs, allocate resources, and deliver projects on schedule and budget

ITAR, Compliance & Risk Management
